# Senior Scheduler

T3W Business Solutions

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4814074528685248958?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=65&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5915192361688685871&crId=US_0US_0)

T3W Business Solutions Inc Description T3W Business Solutions, Inc. is a Woman-Owned Small Business with Headquarters located in San Diego, CA. It is our mission to help our clients develop strategies to optimize their use of space and resources resulting in maximum benefits; we also deliver quality data and analysis to support our client's daily facility operations, planning, and compliance programs. We are looking for an experienced Senior Scheduler .
Contingent Upon Contract Award Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain Critical Path Method (CPM) baseline schedules using Primavera P6 or a more current scheduling platform.
Develop and maintain program- and project-level construction schedules supporting multiple concurrent projects and task orders.
Update schedules on a recurring basis, including preparation of schedule narratives, progress analyses, and milestone status reporting.
Integrate individual project and subcontractor schedules into comprehensive master schedules.
Monitor project milestones, dependencies, float, sequencing, and critical path activities.
Identify potential schedule impacts, delays, conflicts, and areas of concern and develop recommended mitigation strategies.
Analyze contractor-generated construction schedules and provide recommendations regarding schedule acceptability and proposed revisions.
Evaluate schedule performance against approved baselines, planned milestones, and project requirements.
Perform or support Time Impact Analyses (TIA) associated with Requests for Equitable Adjustment (REAs), claims, delays, and other schedule impacts.
Provide scheduling analysis, findings, and recommendations to project managers, construction managers, contractors, and Government stakeholders.
Support multiple projects, subprojects, and task orders in a dynamic construction management environment.
Requirements Minimum Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field
10+ years of experience using Primavera P6 to develop, implement, and maintain construction schedules
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining CPM construction schedules
Experience supporting new vertical construction and renovation projects
Experience with specialized construction environments such as medical facilities, pharmaceutical facilities, and/or heavy-highway construction
Strong knowledge of critical path methodology, schedule logic, sequencing, milestones, float, dependencies, and construction progress
Experience analyzing contractor-generated construction schedules and proposed schedule revisions
Experience preparing schedule narratives, progress analyses, and schedule status reports
Experience conducting or supporting Time Impact Analyses
Ability to clearly communicate schedule findings, risks, impacts, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Must be a U.S. Citizen
Preferred Primavera P6 (or current version) certification
Experience supporting USACE, DoD, or other federal construction programs
Experience supporting large, complex construction programs with multiple concurrent projects or task orders
Experience reviewing construction schedules on behalf of Government customers
Experience supporting REAs, claims, delay analysis, or schedule-related dispute resolution
Experience developing and maintaining integrated master schedules across multiple projects and subprojects
Experience supporting medical, pharmaceutical, heavy-highway, or other specialized construction environments
This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR §§ 60-1.4(a), 60-300.5(a) and 60-741.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. Moreover, these regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability.

# Senior Executive Assistant, Nursig Administration, Full Time, Days

PIH Health

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2687521667806714783?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7885526443196812744&crId=US_0US_0)

The Executive Assistant Sr. is responsible for production of administrative and clinical materials and correspondence, coordinating day-to-day activities and other duties and projects as assigned. Performs high-level secretarial duties in an efficient and effective manner, in accordance with departmental objectives, assuring optimal secretarial services are provided to the highest level of productivity. Activities contribute significantly to the smooth running of the overall department.

PIH Health is a nonprofit, regional healthcare network that serves approximately 3 million residents in the Los Angeles County, Orange County and San Gabriel Valley region. The fully integrated network is comprised of PIH Health Hospital - Whittier, PIH Health Hospital - Downey and PIH Health Good Samaritan Hospital, 27 outpatient medical locations, a multispecialty medical (physician) group, home healthcare services and hospice care, as well as heart, cancer, women’s health, urgent care and emergency services. The organization is recognized by Watson Health as one of the nation’s Top Hospitals, and College of Healthcare Information Management Executives (CHIME) as one of the nation’s top hospital systems for best practices, cutting-edge advancements, quality of care and healthcare technology. PIH Health is certified as a Great Place to Work TM. For more information, visit PIHHealth.org or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram.

**Company Description** Excel Hotel Group is a fully integrated hotel ownership, management, and development company experiencing significant growth in the hospitality industry. The organization is known for creating value through expert renovation, rebranding, and repositioning of hotel properties, delivering superior quality and service as its standard. Associates are at the core of the company’s success, working together to achieve industry-leading guest satisfaction, operating results, and profit margins. Excel Hotel Group promotes creativity, dedication, teamwork, integrity, and an entrepreneurial spirit, which define its corporate character. Headquartered in San Diego, CA, the company remains committed to hotel excellence and exceptional guest experiences.

**JOB SUMMARY:** The Corporate Payroll Manager is responsible for independently overseeing, analyzing, and administering payroll processes across all property entities to ensure timely and accurate compensation for all associates. This role involves interpreting and ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as company policies, while providing exceptional support and service to the General Manager and associates. The position requires the regular exercise of discretion and independent judgment in resolving complex payroll matters, developing workflow improvements, and advising management on payroll compliance and best practices.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

Payroll Operations and Processing

· Oversee and manage the end-to-end payroll cycle for multiple property entities and associates, ensuring accuracy and adherence to deadlines.

· Review, analyze, and validate payroll data and system inputs, identifying discrepancies and determining appropriate corrective action; work closely with Accounting to resolve discrepancies.

· Maintain and update payroll records, including new hires, terminations, and changes in employee status or compensation.

· Manage and process payroll deductions, including benefits, taxes, and garnishments.

· Prepares and processes all manual payroll check requests.

· Maintain payroll inbox and answer employee questions in a timely manner.

· Facilitate associate record changes in the HRIS and ensure proper setup and assignment of documents.

· Effectively maintain all payroll documentation, ensuring adherence to company policy and applicable local, state, and federal laws.

· Serve as an escalation point for payroll discrepancies requiring independent judgment and interpretation of regulations.

Compliance, Audits & Regulatory Reporting

· Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll laws and regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.

· Provide guidance related to federal, state, and local payroll compliance, including tax withholding and garnishments.

· Conduct regular audits of payroll data to ensure accuracy and identify areas for improvement.

· Complete government and compliance-related reports as needed.

· Respond to government agency correspondence, compliance reporting, and requests for information in a timely and accurate manner.

· Prepare and distribute year-end W‑2s and W‑2cs ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws.

· Stay informed about industry trends and changes in payroll regulations to ensure ongoing compliance and best practices.

Payroll Systems, HRIS & Reporting

- Maintain accuracy of employee data in HRIS systems.
- Prepare and distribute payroll reports and summaries for management review, including the Payroll Scorecard.
- Complete annual reports including CA Fair Pay Data Reporting and EEO‑1 Reporting.
- Support system implementations, upgrades, and process improvements.
- Evaluate payroll processes, recommend workflow enhancements, and participate in payroll-related projects, including system upgrades or implementations.

Training, Support & Collaboration

- Collaborate with the HR department to resolve complex payroll-related issues and provide support for employee inquiries.
- Provide training and support to other HR/payroll associates and property leaders as needed (e.g., New GM Training).
- Identify recommendations to scale processes to enhance payroll operational efficiency, including the design and implementation of internal controls and maintenance of payroll policies and procedures.

Administrative & Organizational Responsibilities

- Promote a positive and professional work environment by reinforcing company values and culture.
- Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Human Resources.

**Qualifications**

- Strong expertise in Payroll Administration and Payroll Processing, specifically California experience.
- Demonstrated experience with Payroll Taxes and working with external Payroll Services or payroll systems.
- Knowledge of Garnishments and other statutory deductions, with the ability to ensure compliant handling and documentation.
- Proficiency with payroll software (e.g., ADP, Paycom, or similar) and advanced skills in Excel and data reconciliation.
- Solid understanding of wage and hour laws, benefits-related payroll impacts, and general accounting principles.
- High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Effective communication and customer service skills, with the ability to support associates at all levels of the organization.
- Previous experience in hospitality or multi-unit operations preferred; associate or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field is beneficial.

# Senior Bookkeeper

Location:USCompany:Reem Acra

## Description:

**SENIOR BOOKKEEPER**

Location: New York City, Manhattan

Position: Full-Time \| In-Person

Salary: $80,000–$95,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Experience: Minimum 5 years; 10+ years preferred

_About the Position_

Reem Acra, an internationally recognized luxury fashion house specializing in bridal couture and eveningwear, is seeking a highly experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to oversee the company’s daily financial operations. The ideal candidate will have extensive bookkeeping experience within the fashion and apparel industry, preferably bridal, couture, luxury fashion, or made-to-order manufacturing.

_Key Responsibilities_

● Manage daily bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

● Track client deposits, installment payments, outstanding balances, and final payments for made-to-order garments.

● Monitor production expenses, fabric purchases, embroidery, trims, and garment costing.

● Maintain accurate financial records for wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer transactions.

● Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and vendor statements.

● Monitor outstanding receivables and coordinate collections.

● Oversee payroll-related bookkeeping and expense reporting.

● Prepare monthly financial reports, cash-flow summaries, and reconciliations.

● Track inventory-related costs and coordinate with production teams.

● Work closely with outside accountants on tax preparation and year-end reporting.

_Qualifications_

● Minimum 5 years of professional bookkeeping experience; 10+ years preferred.

● Experience in fashion, apparel manufacturing, bridal, or luxury retail strongly preferred.

● Strong understanding of made-to-order production, client deposits, inventory, and costing.

● Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks andMicrosoft Excel. Experience with Shopify, A2000, or Apparel Magic a plus.

● Experience with invoice processing.

● Comprehensive knowledge in managing accounts receivable, chargebacks, aging reports, and collections processes.

● Experience with domestic and international vendors.

● Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and financial accuracy.

● Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and manage multiple priorities.

● Bachelor's degree, CPA Certified a plus

Benefits: Health Insurance and Dental

_Ideal Candidate_

We are seeking a dependable, hands-on financial professional who understands the operational needs of a luxury fashion house and can take full responsibility for maintaining accurate and timely financial records. The ideal candidate is an accountant with a keen eye for detail, a strong propensity for precision, and the ability to communicate financial information clearly and effectively. The candidate should have a comprehensive background in accounting, financial reporting, and consolidations acquired through at least three years of experience.

_To Apply_

Please submit your résumé, relevant fashion or apparel industry experience, salary expectations, and availability to info@reemacra.com.

# Senior Billing Specialist (Chicago)

Location:Schiller Park, ILCompany:Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP

## Description:

Under the general direction of the Billing Manager and according to established Firm policies and procedures, the Senior Billing Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the Firm's billing operations, including overseeing accurate cash application activities and independently managing the preparation and submission of sophisticated client invoices and electronic billing. This role analyzes and applies client billing guidelines, ensures compliance with client and Firm requirements, and proactively resolves billing issues to facilitate timely and accurate invoice submission.

**Senior Billing Specialist**

The Senior Billing Specialist independently coordinates all aspects of the billing process for attorneys with high-revenue and/or high-volume practices, exercising sound judgment and discretion to meet attorney and client expectations. This position partners closely with attorneys, including Capital Partners, clients, and internal departments, requiring exceptional communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills to deliver outstanding client service.

Ability and availability to work from November 15th through January 31st preferably with minimum scheduled time off (excluding medical/family emergencies) in order to meet billing, e-Billing and collection deadlines at year-end.

Katten offers a hybrid work model, allowing the flexibility to work both on-site and remotely on a regular basis (KattenFlex). This role requires 2-3 days of onsite presence each week.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include, but may not be limited to, the following. Other duties may be requested and/or assigned. Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of the position. Essential functions are primary job duties that an individual must be able to perform successfully with or without a reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

- Manage a portfolio of complex billing assignments supporting partners and other attorneys with large, sophisticated, and diverse books of business. Apply advanced billing expertise, sound judgment, and strong analytical skills to resolve complex billing issues while ensuring timely, accruate billing and exceptional client service.
- Prepare, review, revise, and finalize client invoices utilizing advanced billing methodologies, including consolidated billing, alternative fee arrangements (AFAs), and other customized billing arrangements. Perform comprehensive pre-bill reviews to verify accuracy, ensure compliance with client billing guidelines, identify non-billable or inappropriate time entries, and resolve discrepancies prior to attorney review, preparing invoices for attorney approval and submission.
- Perform detailed analyses of billing discrepancies and account variances, reconciling misapplied funds, resolving billing exceptions, and ensuring compliance with Firm policies and client billing requirements.
- Partner directly with attorneys and Legal Executive Assistants/Legal Administrative Assistants to prepare, review, edit, and finalize client invoices while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to client expectations.
- Liaison between partners and clients regarding billing and payment activities, including annual reporting and analysis, reconciliation of payments to billings, and facilitation of compliance with client legal service provider requirements and outside counsel guidelines.
- Manage billing responsibilities for multi-jurisdictional clients, demonstrating an understanding of varying client requirements, regional considerations, tax implications where applicable, and practice-specific billing nuances across offices and jurisdictions.
- Demonstrate advanced expertise in e-billing by independently managing complex e-billing matters, including invoice appeals and resubmissions, budget-related rejections, rate set administration, and compliance with client billing requirements. Submit electronic invoices through client and third-party e-billing platforms, proactively monitor invoice status, investigate and resolve submission and approval issues, and revise rejected invoices to ensure timely client acceptance and payment.
- Analyze and interpret complex client billing guidelines to proactively identify potential issues, minimize billing delays, and maximize billing compliance and improve invoice acceptance, realization, and collection outcomes.
- Conduct comprehensive reviews of draft invoices to identify non-billable entries, guideline compliance concerns, billing inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve realization and collection performance.
- Serve as a primary billing resource for Team Billing, managing the coordination of billing activities across multiple attorneys, matters, and client engagements. Partner with attorneys, legal assistants, and administrative personnel to ensure timely and accurate billing, interpret client billing guidelines, resolve complex billing issues, and proactively address challenges to support exceptional client service.
- Collaborate with the Accounting Department, as needed, to research and the appropriate application of client payments against outstanding invoices while resolving payment discrepancies.
- Perform periodic reviews of aged work-in-process (WIP) to identify outstanding issues in accordance with Firm guidelines. Prepare recommendations for attorneys regarding WIP write-offs, obtain the necessary approvals, or document business justification for retaining aged WIP balances.
- Maintain active involvement in the collections process by partnering with attorneys, clients, and collections personnel to research outstanding balances, resolve disputed charges, identify barriers to payment, and support timely collection efforts.
- Create detailed Excel reports and spreadsheets for attorneys to support client-specific needs, facilitate informed decision-making, and promote positive client relationships.
- Maintain comprehensive billing notes and detailed client profiles documenting billing preferences, submission requirements, special handling instructions, client specific guidelines and collection considerations to ensure consistency and continuity of service.
- Demonstrate advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills, independently researching and resolving billing discrepancies, client concerns, and process exceptions with minimal supervisory direction.
- Serve as a subject matter resource and mentor to less experienced billing team members by providing guidance on billing procedures, client requirements, Firm policies, best practices, and effective resolution of complex billing issues, promoting consistency, accuracy, and continuous professional development across the team.
- Assist the Billing Manager with special projects, including periodic billing and collection initiatives, process improvement initiatives, testing and implementation of billing system enhancements, ad hoc reporting and other departmental initiatives as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

- Bachelor’s degree is required and 10 or more years progressive billing/e-billing experience preferably in a large legal or professional services firm is required. Demonstrated experience supporting partners or attorneys with complex, high-volume practices. Knowledge of general accounting principles. Advanced knowledge of Elite, Aderant, CMS, or comparable legal billing systems, along with extensive experience using multiple e-billing platforms (Billblast, eBillingHub, etc.).
- Computer proficient with experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word / Excel), Outlook and Adobe.
- Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to mentor, train, and provide informal guidance to team members without direct supervisory responsibility.
- Proven ability to interpret and administer complex client billing guidelines, alternative fee arrangements, consolidated billing structures, and multi-office client relationships.
- Exhibit high degree of initiative in order to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, detail-oriented work environment, and ensure work is completed within strict deadlines. Proactive with excellent troubleshooting, problem resolution, and follow-through skills.
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate with courtesy and diplomacy, efficiently follow written and verbal instructions, provide information, and maintain effective relationships with a diverse group of attorneys, clients, staff, and outside contacts.
- Excellent organizational skills including record keeping, data collection, and system information. Ability to compile and analyze data and furnish information in report/Excel format, written correspondence, e-mail, or verbally.
- Ability to perform mathematical calculations and apply mathematical concepts when computing, reconciling balances, verifying numerical data, processing complex client billing, preparing various billing reports, reconciling appropriation of account funds, and processing write-offs.
- Work occasionally requires more than 37.5 hours per week (35 hours per week in New York) to perform the essential duties of the position.

The annualized salary range for this position is $100,000 to $120,000. Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.

# Senior Payroll Specialist (San Diego)

Location:San Diego, CACompany:Excel Hotel Group

## Description:

**Company Description** Excel Hotel Group is a fully integrated hotel ownership, management, and development company experiencing significant growth in the hospitality industry. The organization is known for creating value through expert renovation, rebranding, and repositioning of hotel properties, delivering superior quality and service as its standard. Associates are at the core of the company’s success, working together to achieve industry-leading guest satisfaction, operating results, and profit margins. Excel Hotel Group promotes creativity, dedication, teamwork, integrity, and an entrepreneurial spirit, which define its corporate character. Headquartered in San Diego, CA, the company remains committed to hotel excellence and exceptional guest experiences.

**JOB SUMMARY:** The Corporate Payroll Manager is responsible for independently overseeing, analyzing, and administering payroll processes across all property entities to ensure timely and accurate compensation for all associates. This role involves interpreting and ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as company policies, while providing exceptional support and service to the General Manager and associates. The position requires the regular exercise of discretion and independent judgment in resolving complex payroll matters, developing workflow improvements, and advising management on payroll compliance and best practices.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

Payroll Operations and Processing

· Oversee and manage the end-to-end payroll cycle for multiple property entities and associates, ensuring accuracy and adherence to deadlines.

· Review, analyze, and validate payroll data and system inputs, identifying discrepancies and determining appropriate corrective action; work closely with Accounting to resolve discrepancies.

· Maintain and update payroll records, including new hires, terminations, and changes in employee status or compensation.

· Manage and process payroll deductions, including benefits, taxes, and garnishments.

· Prepares and processes all manual payroll check requests.

· Maintain payroll inbox and answer employee questions in a timely manner.

· Facilitate associate record changes in the HRIS and ensure proper setup and assignment of documents.

· Effectively maintain all payroll documentation, ensuring adherence to company policy and applicable local, state, and federal laws.

· Serve as an escalation point for payroll discrepancies requiring independent judgment and interpretation of regulations.

Compliance, Audits & Regulatory Reporting

· Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll laws and regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.

· Provide guidance related to federal, state, and local payroll compliance, including tax withholding and garnishments.

· Conduct regular audits of payroll data to ensure accuracy and identify areas for improvement.

· Complete government and compliance-related reports as needed.

· Respond to government agency correspondence, compliance reporting, and requests for information in a timely and accurate manner.

· Prepare and distribute year-end W‑2s and W‑2cs ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws.

· Stay informed about industry trends and changes in payroll regulations to ensure ongoing compliance and best practices.

Payroll Systems, HRIS & Reporting

- Maintain accuracy of employee data in HRIS systems.
- Prepare and distribute payroll reports and summaries for management review, including the Payroll Scorecard.
- Complete annual reports including CA Fair Pay Data Reporting and EEO‑1 Reporting.
- Support system implementations, upgrades, and process improvements.
- Evaluate payroll processes, recommend workflow enhancements, and participate in payroll-related projects, including system upgrades or implementations.

Training, Support & Collaboration

- Collaborate with the HR department to resolve complex payroll-related issues and provide support for employee inquiries.
- Provide training and support to other HR/payroll associates and property leaders as needed (e.g., New GM Training).
- Identify recommendations to scale processes to enhance payroll operational efficiency, including the design and implementation of internal controls and maintenance of payroll policies and procedures.

Administrative & Organizational Responsibilities

- Promote a positive and professional work environment by reinforcing company values and culture.
- Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Human Resources.

**Qualifications**

- Strong expertise in Payroll Administration and Payroll Processing, specifically California experience.
- Demonstrated experience with Payroll Taxes and working with external Payroll Services or payroll systems.
- Knowledge of Garnishments and other statutory deductions, with the ability to ensure compliant handling and documentation.
- Proficiency with payroll software (e.g., ADP, Paycom, or similar) and advanced skills in Excel and data reconciliation.
- Solid understanding of wage and hour laws, benefits-related payroll impacts, and general accounting principles.
- High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Effective communication and customer service skills, with the ability to support associates at all levels of the organization.
- Previous experience in hospitality or multi-unit operations preferred; associate or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field is beneficial.

WSP is seeking a Vice President, Construction Scheduler to join our Project Controls team in the San Francisco bay area.

### Your Impact

### Duties and Responsibilities:

- Provide expert Providing and/or overseeing critical path method scheduling (via Primavera) to support client's Program including design and construction rail transit projects.
- Developing integrated program schedules based on input from the various entities including designer, contractor, third party etc.
- Assess and provide recommendations to resolve schedule, scope changes or delays to the project team and executive management.
- Coordination with project teams to assess reporting and identify risk and create accurate forecasts.
- Responsible for developing, updating, and analyzing detailed execution schedules for simultaneous projects
- Establish baseline schedule: summary and detailed review of baseline durations, logic, resources, costs, cost curves, resource histograms.
- Review periodic CPM Updates, provide Primavera schedule comparison reports and detailed reviews.
- Perform Earned Value analysis reports, schedule change management and review of change orders.
- Perform time impact analyses (TIA) to determine the extent of the impacts of potential delays.
- Provide recommendations for schedule recovery. Recovery schedule reviews and perform what-if scenario analysis.

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management or related discipline or equivalent years of construction scheduling experience.
- 12 years of experience in developing and managing construction schedules for large programs.
- Experience with large-scale tunneling and metro/transit infrastructure projects, including underground construction, station development, and rail systems
- Experienced with critical path method analysis/technique with Primavera.
- Project financial forecasting skills.
- Change Order Analysis, Time Impact Analysis, and Forensic Schedule Analysis.
- Experience working with cross-functional teams.
- Experience working within large and challenging Client Programs with one or more project teams.
- Effective reporting and communication skills.

### Job Description

Job Description

The office manager will be the first point of contact for the internal and external parties. As an excellent organizer, you will prioritize and manage all the different tasks throughout your day. The entire staff will rely on the office manager to support the company operations, maintain order within the office, and often leading the communication as it pertains to its employees.

Objectives of this Role:

· Ensure peak organizational operations and provide preventable measures by identifying issues.

· Implement established policies and procedures, measures outcome against standards, and improve operational flow when identified.

· Oversee office interactions, responding to requests and questions.

· Answering telephone calls and emails from staff

· Monitoring office supplies and ordering new stationery, electronics, etc. as needed.

· Interviewing and setting up ads for new office employees and organizing their employment paperwork

· Reporting office progress to senior management and working with them to improve office operations and procedures.

Daily and Monthly Responsibilities:

· Oversee the day-to-day activities of the office as the main point of contact in the reception area.

· Maintain office efficiency by maintain the appearance of common area, organizing procedures, handling correspondence, managing filing systems, and answering phones and voicemails.

· Manage all aspects of the office space/infrastructure planning (moves, adds, and changes to workstations) and provide answers, resources, and solutions.

· Provide direct administrative support as needed, including scheduling appointments, meeting, and events, booking travel, maintaining filing systems, mailing, and shipping packages, and updating contact database and employee list.

· Oversee and maintain office equipment for uninterrupted function, identify, and fulfill office supply needs, maintain, and manage vendors, and coordinate food delivery as needed.

· Plan Internal Company events only (A1 Hospitality Christmas party, birthdays, and potlucks).

Skills and Qualifications

· 2+ years of office management experience or relevant work experience

· Strong time management and people skills, flexibility, and multitasking abilities

· Advanced computer skills and experience with online platforms

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office, with an aptitude to learn new software and systems.

· Previous success in office management

· Engaging personality and optimistic outlook

· Experience developing internal systems.

· Ability to handle confidential information.

Engineering Student Success Center Administrative Support Coordinator Apply now Job no: 554744
Work type: Staff
Location: San José
Categories: Unit 7 - CSUEU - Clerical and Administrative Support Services, Administrative, Probationary, Full Time, On-site (work in-person at business location)

The Engineering Student Success Center (ESSC) Administrative Support Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative and operational support for the Student Success Center, ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the center while serving as the primary point of contact for students, faculty, staff, and visitors. Working independently under general supervision, this position coordinates front desk operations, manages calendars, maintains department communications and website content, supports budgeting and procurement activities, and coordinates events and special projects. The role also provides administrative support to center leadership, supervises student assistants, and contributes to a welcoming, responsive, and student-centered environment that supports the College of Engineering's student success initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Coordinate daily administrative and front desk operations, providing exceptional customer service to students, faculty, staff, and visitors.
Manage calendars, advising appointments, room reservations, travel arrangements, and meeting logistics for center leadership and staff.
Coordinate procurement activities, reconcile purchases, maintain office supplies, and assist with budget monitoring.
Supervise, schedule, train, and monitor student assistants, including approving timesheets and coordinating front desk coverage.
Maintain and update the department website, digital communications, social media content, and promotional materials.
Prepare correspondence, reports, mailings, newsletters, flyers, and other communications supporting center operations and events.
Maintain records, filing systems, data, and reports while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with university policies.
Respond to inquiries regarding university resources, academic policies, and student services, referring complex issues to appropriate staff.
Coordinate and provide administrative support for special events, orientations, workshops, receptions, and college-wide activities.
Support onboarding activities for new staff and perform special projects and other administrative duties as assigned.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with a strong customer service focus.
Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with diverse populations and stakeholders.
Knowledge of office administration practices, business writing, grammar, and correspondence preparation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn and utilize enterprise systems, databases, web content management systems, and related software.
Ability to organize multiple priorities, manage calendars, coordinate events, and maintain accurate records.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and sound decision-making skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.
Ability to interpret and apply university policies, procedures, and administrative guidelines.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate work in a fast-paced environment.
General awareness of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), and willingness to use them responsibly and ethically.
Required Qualifications
Completion of a high school program, technical/vocational program, or their equivalents
Three years of related office work experience
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrated experience with CMS/PeopleSoft and EAB Navigate/Spartan Connect
Demonstrated experience composing correspondence and reports
Experience working in student services environment in higher education
Demonstrated experience working effectively with individuals from varied backgrounds, including students with diverse educational and socioeconomic experiences

About The Role The Office Administrator is the welcoming first face of the Din Tai Fung Central Kitchen, setting the tone for every guest, candidate, vendor, restaurant operator, and team member who enters the office. This full-time, onsite role (Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM) pairs genuine front-desk hospitality with the behind-the-scenes coordination that keeps the office running: greeting and directing visitors, managing mail and deliveries, supporting catering and office events, and helping keep the workplace stocked, organized, and running smoothly. It's an ideal fit for someone personable and detail-oriented who takes pride in creating a welcoming experience while keeping a busy office organized and running smoothly.
Responsibilities Front desk reception, check-in & visitor experience: Greet, sign in and badge all guests, candidates, vendors, operators and team members as first point of contact; notify hosts of in-person arrivals (workplace chat); escort and provide white-glove care to high-priority and C-suite guests; keep the reception/lobby presentable; serve as a DTF brand & culture ambassador.
Administrative support (Managers and Plant Director): Data entry, filing, scanning, copying; onboarding/welcome-material prep; provide administrative support to the Executive Assistant(s), including delegated and ad hoc tasks as assigned; help executive meetings start smoothly.
Office & PPE Supply Management: Maintain inventory and order office supplies, breakroom necessities, and PPE (boots, cutting gloves, back braces); oversee uniform and first-aid supply coordination with CINTAS.
Mail, packages & courier coordination: Receive, sort and distribute mail and parcels; schedule and receive couriers; sign for and secure deliveries; notify recipients via workplace chat.
Catering & office event support: Plan, order and coordinate catering for office events and meetings; manage headcounts, setup, catering deliveries and cleanup; support event logistics.
Vendor & Facility Coordination: Manage external vendor relationships including Ecolab (sanitation) and Orkin (pest control); oversee office and warehouse deliveries.
Security, safety & confidentiality: Serve as the front-desk safety checkpoint and emergency point person; monitor and control building access; safeguard confidential visitors, documents and conversations with discretion.
Job Requirements High school diploma or equivalent.
Valid Food Handler's Card, or the ability to obtain one within the required timeframe.
Ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.
Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and general computer applications.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and communicate information clearly and professionally with employees, management, and other departments.
Preferred Requirements Previous leadership or supervisory experience in food manufacturing, food production, or a related manufacturing environment.
Experience working in food manufacturing or production operations.
Working knowledge of USDA regulations, HACCP principles, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), food safety requirements, and product traceability systems.
Essential Functions Follow and enforce company policies, food safety standards, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and regulatory requirements.
Protect confidential company information, including proprietary recipes, formulations, and operating procedures.
Stand and walk for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.
Frequently bend, stoop, kneel, twist, reach, and perform repetitive hand and arm movements.
Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.
Work safely in varying environmental conditions, including wet floors and fluctuating temperatures ranging from refrigerated to hot production areas.
Perform other job-related duties as assigned by management.
Special Requirements Ability to work a flexible schedule based on operational needs, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned.
NOTE: This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying the position. Employees will be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their supervisor.
Applicants must be 18 years of age or older and able to provide documentation to work in the United States legally.

# On-call Weekend Scheduler Staffing Coordinator

$20 per hour

Aarris Healthcare

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7024069936032793038?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2595004513186002649&crId=US_0US_0)

Aarris Healthcare is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Weekend On-Call Staffing Coordinator to manage caregiver and nursing staff scheduling while providing weekend coverage support to local clients as needed. The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator who can build and maintain strong relationships with both employees and clients. Experience in a medical office or healthcare administrative work is preferred. The goal is to ensure the agency’s staffing needs are consistently met while fostering a supportive and professional work environment.

Why You’ll Love This Role
Join a team that values your growth and flexibility. This position offers remote work, opportunities for career advancement, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in home healthcare.

Responsibilities

Oversee and manage staffing needs during weekends and holidays

Develop and maintain work schedules by assigning caregivers and nurses to open shifts

Enter, update, and maintain accurate scheduling records

Serve as the point of contact for staff and client questions, concerns, and issues

Manage timekeeping and process time‑off requests

Assist local clients with activities of daily living when coverage is needed

Maintain confidential, up-to-date employee and client records

Be available for on‑call duties throughout the weekend and on holidays

Qualifications & Skills

Prior experience as a staffing coordinator, preferably in healthcare

Strong organizational and leadership abilities

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with staff and clients

Dependable, discreet, and respectful of confidentiality

Self‑motivated with a desire for professional growth

Experience in healthcare staffing, medical administration, or home care is a plus

Schedule
Weekend and holiday coverage required. Shifts are as follows: Friday 6:00 PM - Monday 12:00 AM PST, or Friday 6:00 PM - Monday 6:00 AM PST.

Compensation & Benefits

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Work from home

Full-time

Title: Office Assistant

Industry: Legal / Professional Services

Location: Sacramento, CA 95814

Assignment Type: Direct Hire

Pay: $55,000–$65,000 + bonus

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, fully onsite

Benefits: This position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).

Job Description

The Office Assistant will support the daily operations of the Sacramento office. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, service-minded professional who takes pride in maintaining an organized office, delivering exceptional client service, and anticipating the needs of attorneys, staff, and visitors. The successful candidate will demonstrate discretion, professionalism, and the ability to manage a variety of responsibilities in a fast-paced legal environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Answer incoming calls, greet clients and visitors, and provide a professional, welcoming experience.
- Maintain office organization and appearance, including kitchen cleanliness, coffee service, dishwashing, and conference room preparation.
- Coordinate meeting logistics, including room reservations, catering, lunch setup, place settings, and post-meeting cleanup.
- Manage office supplies, inventory, purchasing, and budget tracking.
- Coordinate mail, deliveries, and courier services, including FedEx and UPS.
- Communicate with outside vendors and building management to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and office needs.
- Assist with office events, special projects, travel arrangements, and expense reimbursements.
- Provide basic technology support under the direction of the Help Desk, including setting up audiovisual equipment for Zoom and Microsoft Teams meetings.
- Maintain a high level of confidentiality while supporting daily office operations and administrative requests.
- Stay proactive during slower periods by identifying and completing tasks that support the office and team.

Qualifications

- 2–3+ years of administrative experience, preferably within a corporate or professional services environment.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with Zoom; familiarity with Microsoft Teams is preferred.
- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, customer-focused demeanor.
- Ability to take thorough notes, retain instructions, and work independently with minimal repeated direction.
- High level of discretion and ability to handle confidential information.
- Strong situational awareness and sound judgment when interacting with clients, attorneys, executives, and visitors.
- Ability to remain flexible, manage competing priorities, and maintain a consistent, reliable schedule.
- Comfortable working in a professional, nonpartisan environment that regularly welcomes political figures and other high-profile visitors.

$19.4 - $24.04 per hour

Eskaton Properties Incorporated

[Rancho Cordova, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Rancho-Cordova%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5122101650530981223?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7222&pageType=7&jobAge=282&jdpSource=101&jdpid=890950200257276754&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Make a Real Difference, Every Single Day**

As a nonprofit leader in aging, Eskaton helps people live well, longer — with trusted guidance at every stage. We believe aging should be a vibrant, supported, and celebrated journey, not an experience to face alone. For over 55 years, Eskaton has been a cornerstone of Northern California, growing a network of 23 communities dedicated to older adults and the people who care for them. When you join us, you're not just starting a job. You're stepping into a career where your work creates a real impact on people's daily lives and strengthening the communities we call home.

**We Invest in You (Because You Invest in Others)**

We know that to take great care of our residents, we must take great care of you. We are genuinely committed to your health, your happiness, and your future. That’s why we offer:

- **Financial Security:** Competitive pay and a 401K matching program to help you plan for your own future.

- **Total Wellbeing:** Comprehensive benefits that support your physical and mental health.

- **A Place Where You Belong:** We celebrate diversity and equity across the entire aging spectrum, ensuring every team member feels seen and valued.

**Our DNA (Core Values)**

We’re looking for people who align with our mission and want to grow with us:

- **Welcoming:** You’re a natural at creating warmth and a sense of belonging for everyone you meet.

- **Bring (Y)our Best:** You take pride in your work and strive for excellence in the "little things" and the "big things" alike.

- **Empowerment:** You don't wait for permission to do the right thing. You step up, take ownership, and lead with initiative.

- **Growth:** You’re a lifelong learner who seeks consistent improvement and sustainable growth.

**Essential Job Functions**

- Operates multi-positioned telephone switchboard to relay incoming, outgoing and inner-office calls, and performs other tasks related to communication.
- Greets visitors, determines their needs, and contacts the proper person.
- Answers general questions and gives general information to those visiting or calling the community.
- Performs a variety of other clerical duties, depending upon project assigned, such as: posting data from one record to another, typing reports, sorting and distributing mail and phone messages, and other related clerical duties.
- Schedules and coordinates tele-conference calls.
- Sorts and distributes mail and other inter-office materials necessary for community operations.
- Schedules and coordinates room calendars.
- Accurately completes assignments according to directions given and performs other duties as required of position.

**Other Job Functions**

- Models and embodies Eskaton’s core values, including:
 - Creating a sense of warmth, welcoming and belonging for all
 - Fostering excellence in everything we do
 - Seeking consistent improvement, learning and sustainable growth
 - Stepping up, taking ownership and leading with initiative
- Fully complies with all provisions in Eskaton’s Corporate Compliance Policy and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
- Maintains attendance as outlined in Eskaton policy.
- Follows required dress code and Eskaton’s Community Appearance Standards. Maintains a professional image to the public and residents.
- Works in accordance with established safety guidelines; uses proper body mechanics; follows safe work practices; wears appropriate safety gear.

**_Compensation_**

**_Starting pay ranges from $19.40 per hour - $24.04 per hour. Factors such as scope, responsibilities, experience, education, job-related skills, internal equity, and market considerations may influence base pay._**

**This position shift is Friday to Monday.**

**Qualifications**

**_Education:_**

High school or equivalent G.E.D., including courses in typing required.

_**Training and Experience:**_

Experience as a receptionist with public contact desirable.  Experience with personal computers and related software preferred. All staff that provide direct care to residents will have current first aid training.

_**Knowledge and Abilities:**_ Knowledge of telephone etiquette, interpersonal communication, typing formats for correspondence and documents, calendaring and filing.

**Work Conditions and Physical Requirements**

Requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.  Notify the Human Resources team to request any accommodation(s) to perform any of the essential functions of this position.

**Light Work**

Exerting up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.  If the use of arm and/or leg control requires exertion of forces greater than that of sedentary work and if the worker sits most of the time, the job is considered light work.

_The final candidate must successfully pass Eskaton's post offer, pre-employment testing which includes a criminal background check, drug test, TB screen test and health screen.  All new hires are required to sign an arbitration agreement as a condition of employment._

_Eskaton is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation or protected veteran status._

# Executive Assistant (Confidential Administrative Support II)

$4,687 - $7,383 per month

Sonoma State University

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7010832590496846044?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4753214154818437478&crId=US_0US_0)

This position is only open to Sonoma State University Employees
Job Summary
Reporting to and under the general direction of the Chief Financial & Administrative Strategy Officer (CFASO), the Executive Assistant is responsible for high-level administrative office management and project coordination. The incumbent is responsible for independently coordinating activities and overseeing a broad range of activities on behalf of the CFASO, division, and the university. This includes, but is not limited to, providing work coordination direction to other administrative and student personnel, interpreting and applying complex operating policies and procedures, performing research, preparing reports with recommended courses of action, making in-depth analytical studies and investigations with broad impact, making recommendations for changes in policy or procedures, handling problems and materials of a highly confidential and often sensitive nature, and supporting a positive, collaborative work environment. On behalf of the CFASO, the incumbent assists in coordinating matters pertaining to RTP, staff performance evaluations, contract interpretation, grievances, complaints, disciplinary actions, and other faculty, staff, and/or management issues. The incumbent also routinely assists in the preparation and handling of confidential materials that relate to management's strategies and positions on matters related to the collective bargaining units and bargaining. This position has been designated "confidential" in accordance with the provisions of the Higher Education Employer-Employee Relations Act (HEERA).

Key Qualifications
This position requires a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of three years of progressively responsible administrative experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the position. Prior experience supporting an executive level position and office management experience is desired. Master's degree and experience within the public sector and/or higher education is highly preferred. Strong technical skills, including intermediate proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office products and database management is required. Knowledge of Google Suite and PeopleSoft and reporting tools (Query), or the ability to quickly gain this knowledge is preferred.

Salary And Benefits
This is a full time, exempt position, which will lead toward permanent status following the successful completion of a probationary period. Starting salary placement depends on qualifications and experience and is anticipated to be in the range of $4,687 to $7,383 a month.

This position is eligible for a broad range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances, retirement (CalPERS), tuition waiver, vacation and sick leave. In addition, 15 paid holidays are offered each year. Sonoma State University is also a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF) Employer.

# Customer Service Manager

$130k - $200k

Aston Carter

Job Title: Customer Service Manager
Job Description
The Customer Service Manager leads customer service operations supporting aerospace OEM and aftermarket customers across multiple sites. This role provides shared oversight of California and Arizona operations, partnering closely with an on-site supervisor to align priorities, strengthen customer communication, and ensure consistent, high-quality service execution. The position combines people leadership, aerospace customer relationship management, and operational improvement, offering broad ownership over order management, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Provide shared leadership of customer service operations across the California and Arizona locations, partnering with the on-site supervisor to align priorities, service standards, and daily execution.

Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 1015 customer service employees, managing workloads, setting clear expectations, and establishing accountability for performance and service quality.

Maintain consistent customer service standards across both locations by monitoring performance, addressing issues promptly, and reinforcing best practices.

Oversee end-to-end order management activities, including order entry, quoting, backlog management, fulfillment, shipments, and expedites, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

Coordinate recovery plans for shortages, late deliveries, and other service disruptions, working cross-functionally to restore delivery performance and communicate realistic commitments.

Manage customer relationships for aerospace OEM and aftermarket accounts by communicating order status, delivery risks, and recovery commitments clearly and proactively.

Resolve customer escalations by investigating issues, coordinating internal stakeholders, and providing timely, well-documented resolutions.

Organize and participate in customer reviews to discuss performance, delivery reliability, backlog status, and improvement actions.

Partner with Sales, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Logistics to address customer needs and ensure aligned responses to complex issues.

Track and report key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, quote turnaround time, response times, and escalation closure rates.

Use ERP systems, Excel, and Power BI to improve visibility into orders, backlog, and delivery performance, and to support forecasting and KPI reporting.

Drive process improvements within customer service by identifying recurring issues, streamlining workflows, and enhancing reporting and data accuracy.

Support ERP and CRM adoption and optimization, ensuring that systems are used effectively to manage customer information, orders, and communication.

Maintain CRM records to document customer interactions, track follow-up actions, and support consistent, transparent communication.

Contribute to commercial and financial activities such as supporting strategic pricing discussions, competitive lead times, payment issue resolution, overdue account recovery, and book-to-bill tracking.

Coordinate customer production-readiness reviews by organizing customer visits and aligning internal teams around demand, existing orders, and delivery readiness.

Support multi-site coordination by working effectively with remote teams and site supervisors to maintain alignment on priorities, capacity, and customer commitments.

Continuously seek opportunities to strengthen processes, improve reporting, and develop team capabilities to enhance overall customer experience and operational performance.

Essential Skills

410 years of related experience and/or training in aerospace customer service, with strong exposure to OEM and aftermarket customer requirements and supply chain processes.

Strong knowledge of aerospace customer requirements, supply chain operations, and OEM/aftermarket workflows, applied to managing relationships, delivery commitments, and escalations.

Demonstrated ability to lead and coach customer service teams, with leadership capability essential and 3+ years of supervisory experience preferred.

Proven experience managing order entry, quoting, backlog, fulfillment, shipments, and expedites using an ERP system such as SAP, Oracle, Infor LN, or an equivalent platform.

Proficiency with Excel, including pivot tables, to support forecasting, analysis, and KPI reporting.

Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools to track delivery performance, backlog, and escalation resolution.

Demonstrated ability to communicate proactively and clearly with customers regarding order status, delivery risks, and recovery plans.

Strong judgment and ownership mindset in resolving customer issues and managing escalations to closure.

Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams in Sales, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Logistics.

Experience in continuous improvement within customer service or operations, focusing on workflow optimization and service quality.

Bachelors degree in business or a technical discipline.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

MBA or other advanced degree is desirable.

Three or more years of leadership or supervisory experience is preferred.

CRM proficiency, including maintaining customer visibility, documenting interactions, and supporting consistent follow-up.

Experience driving process improvement and supporting digital transformation initiatives, particularly related to ERP and CRM enhancements.

Commercial and financial acumen to support strategic pricing discussions, competitive lead-time analysis, payment issue resolution, overdue-account recovery, and book-to-bill tracking.

Experience coordinating customer production-readiness reviews, including planning customer visits and aligning internal teams around demand and delivery readiness.

Prior experience supporting remote teams or partnering with site supervisors to maintain alignment across multiple locations.

Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data from ERP, Excel, and Power BI to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

Effective delegation and workload management skills to balance priorities across teams and locations.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

This position plays an important role in ensuring payroll transactions are complete, accurate, properly supported, and reconciled in accordance with organizational policies and applicable requirements.

The Payroll Coordinator works closely with the Payroll Manager, Senior Payroll Accountant, Human Resources, Accounting, and external retirement plan providers. The position also serves as a backup to the Senior Payroll Accountant and provides support with payroll processing, reconciliations, research, reporting, and other payroll-related activities as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

- Associate degree in Accounting or a related field, or equivalent payroll and benefits experience required.
- 2+ years of payroll, accounting, benefits, or related experience.
- Experience with payroll deductions, reconciliations, employee benefits, and 401(k)/457 plans preferred.
- Experience with Paycom, Sage Intacct, or similar payroll/ERP systems preferred.
- Working knowledge of payroll accounting, journal entries, and benefit reconciliations.
- Intermediate Excel skills with strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines, and work effectively in a high-volume environment.
- FQHC or healthcare accounting experience preferred.
- Detail-oriented, highly organized, and have excellent communication skills.
- Familiarity with non-profit accounting principles and regulations is also highly desirable.
- Commitment and ability to abide by standards of professional ethics and maintain confidentiality.
- Assist and support the Center/Department/Programs to meet standards of High Reliability.

**Essential Responsibilities**

- Coordinate and process 401(k) and 457 retirement contributions, including elections, changes, funding, and submissions.
- Reconcile retirement plan contributions, provider confirmations, payroll records, and related general ledger accounts; research and resolve discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate documentation for retirement plan transactions, audits, testing, and census requests.
- Reconcile employee benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and other benefit deductions to payroll and vendor invoices.
- Perform routine payroll clearing and general ledger reconciliations, including researching and resolving outstanding items.
- Support payroll accruals, reclassifications, adjustments, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
- Assist with biweekly payroll processing, including reviewing payroll data, deductions, adjustments, payroll registers, and reports for accuracy.
- Process payroll corrections, retroactive adjustments, reimbursements, and other payroll-related transactions as assigned.
- Maintain accurate payroll records, reports, files, and supporting documentation in accordance with organizational policies and retention requirements.
- Provide timely and professional support for routine employee payroll questions and payroll-related requests.
- Serve as backup to the Senior Payroll Accountant, including payroll processing, reconciliations, reporting, and other payroll functions.
- Assist with payroll and benefit audits, reporting, special projects, system implementations, and process improvements.
- Follow payroll policies, internal controls, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulations; escalate significant discrepancies or compliance concerns.
- Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, strengthen reconciliations and controls, and support continuity of payroll operations.
- Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned by the Payroll Manager or VP of Finance.

**Benefits**

Successful candidate will receive a regionally competitive salary, above-average health benefits at reduced costs, paid life insurance & long-term disability insurance, an additional voluntary retirement plan with organizational match, and no vesting schedule requirement.

- Paid bereavement and jury duty leave
- 11 paid holidays per year
- Paid time off
- Paid sick leave
- Flexible Spending Program
- Company paid malpractice insurance for all providers
- Professional development hours offered annually

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The work environment is characteristic of an office environment. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; use hands and arms to reach. The employee is also required to stand; walk; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must also possess hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the phone. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using substances and/or not attentive to personal health and safety for themselves or their homes. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the client's use of alcohol and drugs, and the lack of personal care. The employee may also be exposed to bodily fluids (blood, urine) and hazardous chemicals.

Assists in monthly and annual closings.

Knowledge of basic mathematics.

Customer contact skills.

Computer literate.

Written communication skills.

Fire Dispatcher Opportunities in West Sacramento
Fire Dispatchers help coordinate responses to fires, rescue incidents, hazardous conditions, and other emergencies handled by fire services. They receive incident information, alert appropriate resources, and maintain communication with responding crews.

This role requires organized information handling and clear radio communication. Dispatchers must keep incident details current while following established response plans and directions from authorized personnel.

Fire communications operations may require staffing at all hours. Work schedules can include overnight assignments, weekends, holidays, overtime, and additional coverage during major incidents.

What You May Do

Receive and document reports of fires, rescues, alarms, and hazardous conditions

Verify incident locations, access information, and reported risks

Alert stations and dispatch apparatus using approved response assignments

Monitor radio channels, unit availability, and incident status

Relay information about occupants, hazards, and changing conditions

Process requests for additional resources through established procedures

Coordinate mutual-aid communications when assigned

Record dispatch times, unit movements, and significant incident updates

Experience and Education Requirements
A high school diploma or recognized equivalency credential is commonly required. Some employers provide entry-level instruction; others seek experienced dispatchers with fire communications training.

Applicants should be comfortable with computer systems, accurate data entry, maps, and radio communication. Fire dispatch certification, emergency medical dispatch training, or incident-management coursework may be required for particular assignments.

General Conditions of Employment

Meet the hiring agency’s eligibility and minimum age requirements

Complete required background screening and employment assessments

Pass additional pre-employment evaluations when specified

Complete required fire dispatch training and supervised instruction

Maintain certifications and continuing education required for the assignment

Remain available for assigned shifts and emergency staffing requirements

Work Environment and Physical Requirements
Fire Dispatchers usually work indoors at communications workstations with continuous headset, keyboard, and screen use. Major incidents may involve heavy radio traffic and prolonged concentration. The employer determines essential functions and applicable accommodation procedures.

Benefits
Eligible employees may have access to insurance coverage, retirement programs, paid leave, employee-support services, and professional development. Overtime, shift premiums, and other benefits depend on the hiring agency and position classification.

A Skilled Nursing Facility is seeking a motivated and results-driven Admissions & Marketing Coordinator to manage the facility’s admissions process while actively developing referral relationships and supporting census growth. This position combines Admissions, Insurance Verification, Referral Management, and Healthcare Marketing into one key role.

Key Responsibilities

Manage referrals from initial inquiry through admission.

Review and monitor referrals through CarePort and other referral sources.

Knowledge of Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, and managed care preferred.

Strong communication, marketing, organization, and follow-up skills.

Ability to develop relationships with hospital case managers and referral sources.

Must be proactive, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

We need someone who can build relationships, generate referrals, verify coverage, coordinate admissions, and close the loop with case managers.

At InStride, people are our purpose.
We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.

What we're looking for (role overview) :
InStride is seeking an experienced Events Marketing Manager to lead events as a strategic B2B marketing and growth channel. This role will own the strategy and execution of InStride’s event portfolio while partnering closely with Marketing and Sales to ensure events support our go-to-market priorities, engage target accounts and audiences, and contribute to pipeline growth.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional event execution with a broader B2B marketing mindset. You understand that a successful event extends far beyond the event itself and know how to connect events to integrated campaigns, account-based strategies, content, digital channels, and Sales activation to maximize their impact.

You are creative, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented, with the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution. You will continually evaluate where and how InStride invests in events, create memorable experiences for our audiences, and use performance insights to improve impact and ROI.

Skills we’d love to see you show off:

Strategic event marketing : Ability to translate business and go-to-market priorities into an event strategy that engages priority audiences and accounts, supports broader campaigns, and contributes to pipeline growth.

Integrated campaign thinking : Ability to think beyond the event itself and partner across Marketing to activate content, email, digital, ABM, social, and other channels before, during, and after events to maximize reach, engagement, and conversion.

Sales and account alignment : Strong understanding of B2B sales motions and ability to partner with Sales and BDR teams to identify priority accounts, generate meaningful meetings and engagement, and turn event activity into measurable commercial outcomes.

Event management expertise : Strong hands‑on experience across event conceptualization, sponsorships, logistics, staffing, budgeting, attendee experience, lead tracking, on‑site execution, and post‑event follow‑up.

Measurement and optimization : Analytical mindset with experience defining event KPIs, measuring account engagement and pipeline impact, evaluating ROI, and translating performance insights into recommendations for future investment.

Cross‑functional leadership : Ability to bring together Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Design, Product, RevOps, executives, and external partners around a shared event strategy and execution plan.

Project management : Excellent organizational and time‑management skills, with a self‑starter mindset and the ability to independently manage multiple complex projects in a fast‑paced environment.

Who you are (ideal profile) :

5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience owning events, integrated campaigns, field marketing, demand generation, or ABM programs.

Demonstrated experience managing complex in‑person events, sponsorships, executive experiences, and/or virtual events end‑to‑end.

Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and/or ABM platforms to support audience targeting, event activation, attribution, and measurement.

Experience with account‑based marketing and target‑account activation strategies strongly preferred.

Creative, analytical, resourceful, and curious, with a drive for continuous improvement and a willingness to challenge how things have traditionally been done.

How you will create impact (key responsibilities) :

Own InStride’s integrated event strategy across sponsored events, hosted experiences, in‑person programs, virtual events, and webinars, ensuring investments align with go‑to‑market priorities, target industries, priority audiences, and business objectives.

Build the business strategy for priority events , defining the objective, target accounts and personas, desired audience actions, Sales activation plan, supporting marketing channels, and success metrics before execution begins.

Plan and execute customer, prospect, executive, and third‑party events that create memorable experiences while advancing InStride’s broader marketing and commercial objectives.

Own end‑to‑end event execution , including but not limited to sponsorships, vendor selection and contracts, registration, messaging, booth and experience design, marketing materials, staffing, budgets, timelines, and on‑site execution.

Develop Sales activation strategies for priority events , partnering with Sales and BDR teams on target‑account outreach, meeting generation, event messaging, attendee engagement, and timely follow‑up.

Use performance insights to inform future event investments, identifying which events, audiences, formats, and activation strategies generate the greatest business impact and recommending where InStride should increase, change, or reduce investment.

Maintain InStride’s strategic events calendar and portfolio view, ensuring event investments complement broader marketing campaigns and go‑to‑market priorities throughout the year.

Travel may be required
