# Marketing Operations Manager

$100k - $140k

B-Stock

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4397159849151322618?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=702461997096221763&crId=US_0US_0)

B-Stock is hiring a Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the operational and intelligence layer across the entire marketing team. This is an IC role reporting directly to the VP of Strategy, with visibility into every marketing function — content, demand generation, buyer marketing, and seller marketing.

Keep the marketing machine running with rigor: editorial calendars, cross-functional workflows, Braze platform administration, SEO/AEO/GEO infrastructure, CMS governance, content performance reporting, and asset management. This includes identifying and implementing AI automation within the platforms you own (e.g., Braze) to reduce manual lift over time.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Braze Platform Administration & Health

Serve as primary platform owner for Braze — system health, configuration, and resolving platform issues (integration failures, data pipeline breaks, sync errors) as needed

Monitor and continuously optimize platform performance: deliverability, bounce/unsubscribe trends, event tracking accuracy, data sync

Own user management, permission structures, and workspace governance; ensure the platform is configured to support the campaigns the buyer team is building without technical blockers

Maintain and improve data hygiene: segmentation infrastructure, contact properties, event schemas, suppression mechanics

SEO / AEO / GEO Performance Infrastructure

Apply SEO/AEO/GEO standards across published content

Own the operational infrastructure — keyword frameworks, content briefs, optimization checklists, publishing governance — that ensures content meets SEO, AEO, and GEO standards before going live

Ensure all published content meets SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) standards before going live, including structured data, topical hierarchy, and authoritativeness signals

Track organic traffic and content compliance metrics; surface gaps and recommendations, and refine the underlying playbooks

Content itself is created by the content team; this role owns optimization, tagging, and discovery structure

Website Performance & CMS Ownership

Own Payload CMS backend administration — configuration, data integrity, page governance, freshness reviews, and the content asset library (tagging, organizing, archiving) — across bstock.com; day-to-day publishing sits with the content team

Monitor Core Web Vitals, crawl errors, broken links, and mobile usability; maintain a freshness standard (evergreen pages quarterly, high-traffic monthly) and deliver a regular health summary to marketing leadership

Own the publication SLA — time from content approved to content live — and hold the process accountable when pages sit in queue

Build and maintain the methodology for tracking B-Stock's share of voice in AI-generated search responses

Marketing Operations & Cross-Functional Workflow

Identify and implement AI-enabled automation within Braze and the GEO/content-optimization platform to reduce manual lift in campaign QA, segmentation upkeep, and content compliance checks

Run the master editorial calendar and ensure all functions are coordinated on timing, dependencies, and priorities

Serve as the connective tissue between marketing sub-functions and with sales, product, and customer success on shared programs

Flag redundancies and recommend consolidation across the marketing tech stack

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

4+ years of experience in marketing operations, content operations, or a closely related function at a SaaS or marketplace company

Hands-on platform administration of a marketing automation or customer engagement platform — configuration, data integrity, integrations (Braze strongly preferred; Iterable, Klaviyo, or similar)

Hands-on CMS ownership — publishing, auditing, governance — including headless/developer-forward platforms

Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, with familiarity in how AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) are reshaping content discovery

Practical experience applying AI tools within marketing workflows

High ownership orientation — designs processes that scale without babysitting, spots gaps before they become problems, and translates operational complexity into plain-language recommendations for senior leadership

Practical, hands-on experience applying AI tools within marketing operations workflows and building automations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Direct experience with Braze and/or Payload CMS specifically

THE COMPANY
B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. Company Description RRD provides marketing, packaging, print, and business services to the world’s most respected brands. The company’s proprietary technology, advanced data analytics, and expertise fuel organizational decision-making from strategy through execution, delivering sustainable solutions with the lowest possible environmental impact. Global organizations and regulated industries trust RRD to reduce complexity and drive audience connections across the entire customer journey.
Job Description This role is the face of a busy and highly professional law firm with approximately 120 employees across three floors. The firm is focused on elevating its front-of-house experience, so they're looking for someone who is polished, personable, proactive, and genuinely enjoys creating a welcoming environment for clients, visitors, and employees.
On a day-to-day basis, you'll be responsible for greeting clients and guests, managing visitor registrations and security logs, issuing and maintaining access cards, handling parking validations, coordinating meeting room schedules, answering and directing calls through a multi-line phone system, and providing general administrative support. You'll also assist with catering arrangements and help ensure conference rooms and visitor spaces are ready for meetings and events.
This position works closely with the Senior Office Services Associate to deliver a concierge-style experience for guests, including coordinating visitor arrivals and ensuring every interaction reflects the firm's high service standards.
The ideal candidate will have prior receptionist experience, ideally within a legal, corporate, banking, or other professional services environment. Strong communication skills, excellent typing ability, attention to detail, professionalism, and a positive, team-oriented attitude are essential. Candidates with both reception and office services experience may have additional opportunities for growth and development within the organization.
Schedule :40 hours per week, Monday-Friday 8am-5pm with a 1-hour unpaid lunch break
Work format : Fully onsite
Job duties
Coordinate and manage conference room and meeting reservations, ensuring rooms are properly scheduled and prepared for internal meetings, client visits, and special events
Answer incoming calls, received on a multi-line phone system, in a cordial, professional and timely manner. Transfer calls to appropriate individuals
Greet clients and visitors to the office with warmth and professionalism. Notify employees of visitor’s arrival when necessary
Register visitors and guests in building security systems, maintain accurate visitor logs, and ensure all security protocols are followed
Provide white-glove, concierge-style service to clients, staff, and guests, ensuring a welcoming and seamless experience
Partner closely with Office Services personnel to coordinate guest arrivals, meeting logistics, room setup, and visitor escorts throughout the office
Communicate with manager and client on job or deadline issues
Handle additional projects as assigned. Handle sensitive and/or confidential document and information
Communicate with supervisor or client on job or deadline issues
Meet contracted deadlines for accepting, completing, and delivering all work
Troubleshoot basic equipment problems
Prioritize workflow
Interact with clients in person, over the phone or electronically
Adhere to Williams Lea policies in addition to client site policies
Use equipment and supplies in a cost-efficient manner
Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent
Minimum of two-year receptionist, switchboard or administrative assistant experience required preferably in a banking, legal or large corporate environment
Exceptional customer service skills to effectively communicate with callers, visitors, client and coworkers
Ability and willingness to learn in-depth knowledge of the company (the business and employees) to more efficiently handle calls and greet visitors
Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment
Ability to handle business matters with professionalism
Attention to detail with an emphasis on accuracy and quality
Intermediate computer skills including Microsoft Word and Excel
Ability to prioritize work to balance multiple projects and deadlines
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Self-motivated and the ability to multi-task
Must work well in a team environment
Must be able to interact effectively with multi-functional and diverse backgrounds
Must be self-motivated with positive can-do attitude
Additional Information The salary range for this role at the noted RRD location is $20.53 - $28.70 / hour. Starting pay decisions are determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, skills, experience, certifications, proficiency, performance, shift, location, and other business needs. Typically, roles follow step progressions to a target rate or set increments over time. Depending on the role, in addition to the hourly rate of pay, the total compensation package may also include overtime, shift differential, call-in, and/or stand-by pay. RRD’s benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, life insurance and other voluntary supplemental insurance coverages, plus parental leave, adoption assistance, tuition assistance and employer/partner discounts.
At RRD, we value innovation, authenticity, and integrity. To uphold the security and fairness of our hiring process, we ask that candidates refrain from using AI tools during interviews to ensure an authentic and secure experience. We appreciate your cooperation as we work to maintain a transparent and equitable hiring process.
All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of both a pre-employment background and drug screen.

# Medical Receptionist ( Vietnamese & English Speaking)

Vivo HealthStaff

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7561057243200655350?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=474&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5267009158443238882&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Vivo HealthStaff is seeking a Clinical Lab Scientist for a lab in the SF East Bay. This is a long-term temporary W2 position with benefits that can convert into a permanent position with our client.

**DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:**

01. Greet and screen all incoming visitors and direct them appropriately based on nature of visit; greet participants when they arrive and ensure they are seen by appropriate staff and directed to the appropriate program; ensure that visitors sign in and out of logbook or system and have appropriate ID name tags on.
02. Answer and screen all main phone line incoming telephone calls, engage the language line (interpreter services) as-needed, and direct all calls to the appropriate team; provide accurate program and services information; monitor the main phone voicemail account and return or direct messages appropriately.
03. Demonstrate knowledge of and uphold established policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program, safety and regulatory standards.
04. Champion Healthcare Hospitality through the On Lok practice of G.R.E.A.T. for 5-Star service at the center.
05. Provide appropriate program and service information to program participants and advocate for them to ensure they are receiving attention timely.
06. Communicate regularly with Program Manager and/or Center Support Supervisor to provide feedback on center functioning, report inefficiencies, and propose strategies to improve workflows and processes that serve our team members and participants.
07. Organize mail and other packages; inform appropriate person/distribute accordingly.
08. Assist center staff & IDT members with administrative tasks as requested, including but not limited to assisting kitchen team with portable meal labeling on bags, assisting clinic staff with paperwork from providers, and assisting transportation with coordinating schedules.
09. Lock entry and/or fire exit upon closing; in coordination with program staff and security team, share responsibility for security of all entrances and exits to building.
10. May be responsible to support trouble shooting of on-call administrators and Medical Doctors (MDs).
11. All other reasonably related jobs as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS (knowledge, skills, abilities):**

01. High School graduate or equivalent required.
02. Minimum of two (2) years of work experience in a customer-facing administrative role (i.e. walk-in customer service, reception).
03. Minimum one (1) year experience working with the frail or elderly in a volunteer or professional capacity.
04. Experience and excitement to work with a diverse population of colleagues and participants.
05. Excellent interpersonal skills, including ability to communicate in a professional and warm manner and provide clear and accurate verbal and written communications.
06. Thrive in a busy, engaging environment with multiple interruptions and varied types of work.
07. Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks and conduct thorough follow-up.
08. Bilingual ability may be required for specific assignments (Bilingual Spanish/English, Mandarin/English or Cantonese/English).
09. Computer proficient with experience in Microsoft Office Suite, scheduling systems, and other relevant office technology.
10. Familiarity and moderate technical understanding of office equipment; ability to troubleshoot and report issues to servicers, as needed.
11. Experience working with dementia population, preferred.
12. Experience with electronic health record system preferred.
13. Experience working within the framework of an interdisciplinary team preferred.

# Executive Assistant

Entangl,Inc.

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7822179713377996998?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8743838169836641625&crId=US_0US_0)

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to work directly with our CEO and keep the day-to-day running smoothly. You will own scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, and follow-ups, making sure the CEO’s time goes toward the things that matter most.

We want someone who notices what needs doing, takes ownership, and sees it through. You should be comfortable with changing priorities, communicate clearly, and have excellent judgment about what to handle yourself and what to escalat.

What You’ll Do

Own the CEO’s calendar. Prioritize meetings, resolve conflicts, protect focused work time, and make sure the schedule reflects the company’s priorities.

Manage communications. Organize the inbox, flag important messages, draft responses, and track conversations that need follow‑up.

Keep commitments moving. Maintain a clear record of actions, owners, and deadlines. Follow up with the right people and flag delays before they become problems.

Prepare for meetings. Gather relevant context, prepare concise briefs, and make sure materials are ready. Capture decisions and next steps when needed.

Arrange travel. Coordinate flights, hotels, transport, and itineraries across time zones. Handle changes quickly and pay attention to the details.

Coordinate logistics. Organize customer visits, interviews, team events, and other activities involving the CEO.

Handle administration. Keep expenses, documents, and records organized, and treat sensitive information with discretion.

Improve how we work. Build simple systems that reduce repeated work and make it easy to see what is outstanding.

What We’re Looking For

Experience supporting a founder, executive, or senior leader in a demanding environment.

Excellent organization and attention to detail. Names, dates, bookings, and commitments need to be correct.

Strong written and verbal communication. You can turn a complicated situation into a clear update.

Reliable follow‑through. You close tasks without needing repeated reminders.

Good judgment, discretion, and confidence working with senior customers, investors, and colleagues.

Comfort with technology, including calendar tools, spreadsheets, and AI tools. You review your work and take responsibility for its accuracy.

The ability to coordinate across time zones and adapt when plans change.

# Executive Assistant (CEO)

YMCA of the East Bay

[Berkeley, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Berkeley%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5201116251770545034?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5897&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4896609517675863097&crId=US_0US_0)

## Executive Assistant

The YMCA of the East Bay is seeking an Executive Assistant to join a high-performing leadership team to serve the greater East Bay. This role supports the CEO and will be a key member of the leadership team.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

These general functions will be carried out in keeping with the Goals, Mission and Policies of the YMCA of the East Bay. Provide comprehensive executive-level administrative support to the Chief Executive Officer and Executive Office. Serve as a trusted partner by coordinating executive communications, managing complex scheduling, supporting the Board of Directors and Executive Committee, maintaining confidential records, coordinating meetings and travel, overseeing executive office operations, and ensuring the efficient functioning of the Executive Office while advancing the mission and strategic priorities of the YMCA of the East Bay.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

- Provide exemplary customer service to staff, volunteers, Board members, community partners, donors and visitors that models relationship-building skills in all interactions.
- Provide comprehensive executive administrative support to the Chief Executive Officer, exercising sound judgment, discretion, initiative and professionalism in all matters.
- Manage and maintain the CEO's complex calendar, scheduling appointments, meetings, speaking engagements and other commitments while balancing competing priorities.
- Coordinate logistics for internal and external meetings, retreats and committees including scheduling, meeting materials, catering, technology, room reservations and follow-up communications.
- Respond to ongoing strategic requests from the CEO.
- Research areas of inquiry for the CEO.
- Serve as primary administrative support for the Board of Directors, Executive Committee and other assigned Board committees by:
 - Preparing agendas and informational meeting packets.
 - Recording accurate meeting minutes
 - Distributing approved minutes and materials.
 - Coordinating meeting locations and logistics.
 - Maintaining Board files and governance records.
- Arrange travel for the CEO, including itineraries, transportation, lodging, registrations and expense documentation.
- Draft, prepare, edit and proofread correspondence, reports, presentations and other communications on behalf of the CEO, ensuring accuracy, professionalism and appropriate tone.
- Maintain confidential records and handle highly sensitive organizational, personnel, legal and financial information with the highest degree of discretion and confidentiality.
- Maintain executive office files, records and databases, including Board records, contact lists and mailing databases, ensuring information remains accurate, current and secure.
- Oversee day-to-day Executive Office operations including office supply inventory and ordering, mail distribution, work order requests, office organization and workspace maintenance.
- Support executive leadership meetings by preparing materials, tracking action items and following up on assignments as directed.
- Coordinate and provide administrative support for organizational special events, donor events, recognition activities and other executive initiatives.
- Assist with special projects requiring research, data collection, report preparation and cross-departmental coordination.
- Attend and actively participate in staff meetings, trainings, organizational events and other meetings as assigned.
- Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer for extended periods of time and be able to communicate using a computer and phone/smart device. The employee frequently is required to sit and reach and must be able to move around the work environment
- The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds
- Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust
- The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

- High school diploma or GED required; Associate or Bachelor degree preferred.
- Five or more years of progressively responsible executive administrative support experience, preferably supporting a CEO, Executive Director or other senior executive.
- Experience supporting Boards of Directors and preparing Board meeting materials and minutes strongly preferred.
- Exceptional organizational, planning and project management skills.
- Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
- Proven ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment in handling sensitive matters.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Teams and other office productivity software.
- Ability to relate effectively to diverse groups of people from all social and economic segments of the community.

**OUR AMAZING BENEFITS:**

- Health, dental, vision and life insurance
- 6 weeks of Paid Time Off annually
- 8 YMCA holidays plus 4 floating holidays
- Retirement plan YMCA contribution of 10% of salary after 2 years of employment
- Tuition reimbursement
- Flexible spending account
- YMCA membership at Y NorCal fitness center locations

**HYBRID WORK:**

- 4 days in office, 1 day remote (with options for Zoom board meetings)

# Executive Assistant

$125k - $140k

Air

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8032282098037971180?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=186&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2123138085693500723&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Company Description**

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO), serving as a critical partner in enabling leadership effectiveness at a rapidly growing, mission-driven company.  This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-growth environment, anticipates needs before they arise, and can seamlessly manage constant re-prioritization.

In order to do this job well, you must be a trusted partner with a relentless intolerance of mediocrity.  You manage complexity to maximize availability and the high-touch engagement model of Air executives.  You are exceptionally organized, proactive, discreet, and able to manage competing priorities with sound judgment and urgency. You are also scrappy and resourceful, comfortable rolling up your sleeves to solve problems (Swiss Army Knife mentality).  You thrive behind the scenes, take ownership without waiting for direction, and understand that no detail is too small when it comes to enabling exceptional execution and advancing a critical mission.

This role is a full-time position located in San Francisco, CA.

This role may require up to 10% travel.

Scope of Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end executive support for the Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO), expertly managing evolving priorities, schedules, and daily operations across time zones, optimizing time and commitments while anticipating needs, resolving conflicts, and independently solving logistical challenges
- Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, serving as a trusted point of contact on behalf of the CPTO and ensuring timely, thoughtful follow-through.
- Manage incoming and outgoing communications, track follow-ups, action items, and commitments to ensure seamless execution across the Product and Engineering teams across multiple time zones
- Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, pre-reads, and post-meeting follow-ups to drive clarity and accountability
- Coordinate complex travel arrangements, including flights, ground transportation, accommodations, and detailed itineraries; proactively adjust as plans change
- Maintain accurate expense reporting
- Support planning and execution of leadership offsites, strategy sessions, and company events as needed
- Contribute to cross-functional initiatives, special projects, and evolving administrative priorities
- Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for SF employees, visitors, candidates, and visiting executives, ensuring a polished and welcoming workplace experience.
- Manage day-to-day office needs within the coworking environment, including access, meeting spaces, supplies, mail and deliveries, workplace readiness, and issue resolution.

Qualifications

- U.S. Citizenship is required
- Bachelor's Degree

**Required Skills:**

- 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-suite or senior executives, ideally with additional office management or workplace operations experience in a high-growth technology or startup environment.
- Experience working in ambiguous and fast-paced environments
- Experience with AI tools (e.g. Google Gemini, Claude) and embedding them to operational and organizational work
- Capable of producing high-quality content on short deadlines
- Ability to manage multiple streams of work and plan, organize, and prioritize appropriately
- Fast learner and able to work independently with minimal supervision
- Exceptional attention to detail; ability to consistently produce timely and error-free work
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Superb judgment and proven ability to handle confidential information
- Highly proactive and resourceful self-starter with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and operate effectively with minimal supervision.
- Enthusiastic team member with a positive disposition and attitude

**Desired Skills:**

- Active U.S. security clearance or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship.
- Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, or Defense Tech leadership teams.

_**Base salary for this role is estimated to be $125,000 - $140,000/year.**_

_We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance.  If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we're eager to hear from you._

**Air is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans status or any other characteristic protected by law.**

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**

- Leadership & Team Management:


 - Supervise and motivate the Front Desk team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high levels of guest satisfaction.
 - Manage daily operations of the front desk, including staffing, scheduling, and delegating tasks to ensure efficient workflows.
 - Monitor team performance and provide regular feedback, including conducting performance reviews and setting goals.
 - Handle recruitment, training, and development of front office staff, ensuring adherence to company policies and service standards.
- Guest Service & Problem Resolution:


 - Ensure that all guests receive a warm, welcoming check-in and check-out experience, addressing any concerns or requests promptly and professionally.
 - Resolve complex guest issues or complaints, ensuring high levels of guest satisfaction and following up to ensure resolution.
 - Provide guidance on handling guest requests, special accommodations, and unique situations to front desk agents.
 - Ensure that all guests depart with a positive impression of their stay, including addressing any final billing or service-related issues.
- Team Supervision & Staff Development:


 - Supervise and lead a team of Front Desk Agents, ensuring they meet or exceed service expectations.
 - Schedule shifts, monitor attendance, and ensure adequate staffing levels to meet operational needs.
 - Train and mentor new Front Desk Agents, providing guidance and support to develop their skills and ensure adherence to hotel policies and procedures.
 - Lead by example, demonstrating excellent customer service, attention to detail, and professionalism.
 - Maintain team motivation and morale by fostering a positive work environment.
- Daily Operations Management:


 - Oversee the smooth operation of the Front Desk, ensuring that all guest inquiries, reservations, and requests are handled efficiently and accurately.
 - Monitor and manage room availability and ensure that all guest needs are met according to the hotel’s standards.
 - Conduct regular quality checks to ensure that all Front Desk procedures are being followed properly.
- Administrative & Reporting Tasks:


 - Ensure that guest information is accurately entered into the reservation system and billing is correct.
 - Handle financial transactions such as cash handling, credit card verification, and posting charges accurately.
 - Prepare reports on daily operations, occupancy, revenue, and guest satisfaction metrics, providing feedback to management for continuous improvement.
- Security & Safety:


 - Ensure the safety and security of guests, team members, and hotel property at all times.
 - Adhere to all hotel policies and procedures related to emergency protocols, health, and safety guidelines.
- Inventory & Supply Management:


 - Ensure that Front Desk supplies, such as registration forms, key cards, brochures, and office equipment, are adequately stocked and organized.
 - Perform inventory checks as needed and coordinate ordering of supplies.

**Education and/or Experience**

- High School Diploma or equivalent required.
- A degree in Hospitality Management or a related field is a plus.
- Previous experience in a front desk or supervisory role in a hotel environment is required.
- Experience with hotel reservation systems (e.g., InforHMS, Alice, or similar).

**Skills/Specialized Knowledge**

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
- Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Physical Demands**

- Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time.
- Ability to occasionally lift or move up to 20 pounds.

# Front Desk Coordinator

$26 - $28 per hour

WestCoast Children's Clinic

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/638821543495368420?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=714&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6103683383005878543&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. **_Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity._**

**Position Details**

**Title** : Front Desk Coordinator (Bilingual Spanish)

**Classification** : Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly), 40 hours/week

**Location** : Oakland, CA / In-person

**Regular Work Schedule** : Monday-Friday

**Compensation:**

- $26.00-$28.00 per hour

We are seeking a proactive and dependable **Front Desk Coordinator** to serve as the primary welcoming face of the WestCoast Children's Clinic office. In this role, you will oversee daily administrative operations, coordinate facilities and events, and support staff across clinical, finance, and training departments to ensure a smooth, secure, and welcoming environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Greet clients, staff, and visitors, directing them to their correct destinations.
- Answer and redirect incoming phone calls on a multi-line system and forward website inquiries.
- Handle incoming and outgoing mail and packages, including logging deliveries, creating shipping labels, and distributing items.
- Provide immediate responses to building safety and emergency issues, helping maintain a safe and sustainable work environment.
- Issue parking passes to new staff and coordinate paycheck distribution with the finance team.
- Assist clinical, QA, and other staff with mailing documentation and packages to outside partners and clients.
- Navigate and maintain organizational Google calendars, collaborating cross-departmentally for accuracy.
- Manage inventory, ordering, and ad-hoc requests for office supplies, program treatment materials, swag, and ergonomic needs.
- Assist the Facilities Coordinator with events and collaborate closely with the Facilities Manager on various projects.
- Interact with all staff and clients in a manner that demonstrates ownership and builds trust.

**Key Qualifications:**

- BA/BS preferred
- At least two (2) years of reception/office administrative experience
- Written and spoken fluency in Spanish **required\***

**Competencies (skills, abilities and knowledge):**

- Professional demeanor and client-focused customer service in high-stress, intensive clinical environments
- Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear information exchange across all levels
- Strong ability to multitask with high attention to detail, time management, and initiative
- Versatile team player who works effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams
- Deep awareness of race, class, and ethnicity issues with extensive experience serving diverse communities
- Creative problem-solver capable of managing complex tasks like agency-wide calendaring
- Highly reliable with strict adherence to file, document, and client confidentiality standards
- Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint), Google Workspace, Mac OS, Asana, Neon, Airtable, Welligent, and Zoom

**\*Spanish Language Proficiency Requirement**

This is a bilingual Spanish/English position. Candidates must demonstrate advanced Spanish language proficiency in order to effectively provide services to Spanish-speaking clients and families.

Final candidates will be required to complete an ALTA Language Proficiency Test administered by WestCoast Children's Clinic and must achieve a **minimum score of Level 9 (Advanced)** to qualify for the position.

**A Level 9 proficiency indicates the ability to:**

- Participate in in-depth conversations in Spanish across a broad range of topics at a normal rate of speech
- Understand most spoken Spanish in professional and conversational contexts, using context to interpret unfamiliar slang, idioms, or complex grammar
- Communicate clearly and effectively on a wide range of subjects, even if some grammatical errors or a noticeable accent are present
- Be readily understood by native Spanish speakers without causing misunderstanding
- WestCoast Children's Clinic will provide the ALTA language assessment to eligible candidates during the hiring process.

**_Why work here?_**

**-Be part of a compassionate, driven team that is social justice-focused:** We have Staff Affinity Groups such as Staff of Color, LGBTQ+, Equity and Inclusion, Health and Wellness, and more!

**-Make a difference for the Bay Area's most vulnerable populations:** We serve hundreds of vulnerable kids and their families each year to create positive changes in their lives!

**-Access a growth-oriented learning community:** As a Joint Commission Accredited agency, we are dedicated to providing the highest standard of care, and offer extensive clinical trainings and seminars led by field experts.

Benefits:

- Employer-paid Medical Benefits for Employees
 - 100% employer-paid dental and vision
 - Dependent medical, dental and vision (50% employer-paid)
- Medical and Dependent Care FSA and commuter plans
- 100% employer-paid life insurance long-term disability insurance
- Voluntary accident, term life and hospital indemnity insurance
- 403(b) and ROTH retirement plan options, employer contribution targeted at 7.5% after first year of employment
- Annual incentive compensation (10%)
- Three weeks PTO during the first year of employment, 4+ weeks PTO with additional years of service
- 12 paid holidays plus one paid floating holiday per year
- 4 paid self-care days per year
- Wellness stipend ($100.00 per month)
- Professional development stipend and CEUs for trainings
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**_Join us and make a difference in the lives of vulnerable children and families in the Bay Area._**

_WCC is passionate about leading and encouraging open conversations around race, gender, power, and privilege and how these impact community mental health._ _We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diminishing the influence of privilege and discrimination in our field and our workplace, whether due to differences concerning age, citizenship, color, disability, marital or parental status, race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation._

$70k - $80k

Arbmechanical

AR&B is seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Specialist to support the day-to-day financial operations of our growing mechanical construction business.
This role is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of vendor invoices and payments while helping ensure costs are properly documented, approved, coded, and recorded. The right candidate will be organized, dependable, comfortable working with a high volume of transactions, and able to communicate professionally with both vendors and employees.
The position is well suited for someone who enjoys owning their responsibilities, solving discrepancies, and becoming a trusted resource within a finance and operations team
Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounts payable processing from invoice receipt through payment.
Review invoices for accuracy, appropriate approvals, supporting documentation, and proper accounting and job-cost coding.
Match invoices to purchase orders, commitments, receipts, or other supporting documentation as applicable.
Enter and maintain accurate invoice and vendor information within the company's accounting system.
Prepare and support regularly scheduled vendor payment runs—including checks and electronic payments.
Reconcile vendor statements and proactively research missing invoices, duplicate charges, credits, and other discrepancies.
Communicate directly with vendors regarding invoices, payment status, account discrepancies, and other AP-related questions.
Maintain accurate vendor records and required documentation, including W-9 information.
Work with project managers, service, purchasing, operations, and accounting personnel to obtain approvals and resolve invoice or coding questions.
Coordinate requests for and maintain Certificates of Insurance (COIs), working with vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure required insurance documentation is current and complete.
Order and maintain office supplies, monitor routine inventory needs, and coordinate purchases to support the day-to-day operation of the San Francisco office.
Process union fringe benefit hours and related payments, ensuring hours are accurately reported, and payments are submitted in accordance with applicable union requirements and deadlines.
Prepare and process preliminary notices for applicable projects, ensuring required project information is accurate, and notices are completed and distributed within established timelines.
Support payroll processing, including reviewing time and payroll information for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and assisting with the timely and accurate completion of payroll.
Assist the finance team with month-end accounts payable cutoff, reporting, reconciliations, and accrual support.
Assist with annual 1099 preparation and requests related to audits or financial reviews.
Maintain organized electronic records and documentation consistent with AR&B's internal accounting controls.
Identify opportunities to make AP processes more efficient, accurate, and consistent.
Provide additional accounting and administrative support to the finance team as needed.
Qualifications 3+ years of accounts payable or closely related accounting experience.
Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to organize and prioritize a significant volume of transactions and competing deadlines.
Ability to research discrepancies and follow an issue through to resolution.
Experience independently processing invoices and managing routine vendor relationships.
Comfortable working directly with employees at different levels of an organization as well as outside vendors.
Reliable, professional, and comfortable taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and standard business applications.
Experience with accounting or Foundation software
Call to Action This is an exceptional opportunity to play a critical role within a growing construction organization that values discipline, accountability, and long-term employee relationships. If you thrive in a fast-paced operational environment, we want to hear from you.
Company Culture As a family-owned company for over a century, we have built a culture centered around loyalty, accountability, craftsmanship, and long-term commitment to both our employees and customers. We believe great people build strong companies, and we are committed to creating an environment where employees can build stable, meaningful careers with us.
This position is based at AR&B Mechanical's San Francisco headquarters at 2833 3rd Street in the Dogpatch. The regular schedule is Monday through Friday, 7:30-8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. This is an in-person position and is not structured as a remote or hybrid role . Regular and reliable attendance is an important part of the position.
AR&B Mechanical Contractor is an equal opportunity employer committed to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
AR&B provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and for applicants' sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship.
Salary Range We will consider a wide range of experience and qualifications for this role, and compensation will vary based on experience and demonstrated capability. The starting range for an AP Specialist is $70,000-80,000.

$70 per hour

Eastridge Workforce Solutions

Eastridge Workforce Solutions is committed to connecting skilled professionals with meaningful career opportunities. We are seeking a Billing Specialist to support our client's team.

Created/Revised Date: 10/07/2026

Anticipated Closing Date: 11/07/2026

Job Title: Billing Specialist

Location: Remote (US)

The hourly rate for this position is expected to be between $70.00 - 70.00 per hour, depending on geographic location, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Employment Type: Temporary, approximately 1 year

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Schedule: Monday - Friday, standard business hours (no time zone preference)

Job Summary:

- Serve as a front-line contact for high-volume customer billing and invoice-to-cash questions, owning each case from open to close within team SLAs
- Own internal escalations from Sales and GTM teams, getting answers from Billing, Sales Ops, RevOps, Tax, and Support
- Work directly with customers to get missing remittances, clarify details, and send clear responses until each issue is closed
- Support Collections and Cash Application with payment research, unapplied cash investigations, and admin and transactional work
- Reconcile customer ledgers across the payment processor, billing systems, and GL when payments, credits, or balances don't match
- Spot recurring process and system gaps and flag them for fixes
- Escalate and track system configuration and engineering fixes until they're resolved

Requirements:

- 2-5 years of customer-facing experience in accounts receivable, billing operations, order to cash, finance operations, or high-volume customer operations
- Intermediate Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivots, and reconciliation logic
- Experience working a ticket or case queue and understanding how customer contracts translate into invoices
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to catch variances and mismatched invoice numbers or dates
- Clear, professional written communication with customers and internal partners
- Experience with Stripe, NetSuite, Tesorio, JIRA, or similar tools, plus exposure to SaaS or usage-based billing, preferred
- Able to work remotely in the US, manage a queue on your own, and reprioritize quickly; daily use of AI tools is a plus

## Payroll Temp

Our purpose at Peet's Coffee is the pursuit of better, better coffee, for people and the planet. Our ambition is to become the chosen brand for coffee lovers around the world, and we know earning that place means an uncompromising focus on quality, craft, and authenticity.

As part of Keurig Dr Pepper and JDE Peet's, the world's leading pureplay coffee company, Peet's is growing as a global coffee brand anchored by a clear set of values that reflect who we are today and where we're going. We Dare to Amaze, Own It, Make It Simple, and Win Together challenging ourselves every day to do better than the day before.

We've learned that the secret to great coffee is the people who make it, and we apply the same care in selecting and preparing our teams as we do when crafting the perfect cup.

The Payroll Temp operates within a high-volume, detail-driven U.S. payroll environment using Workday Payroll for processing and D365 for financial reconciliation. The temp will manage recurring operational tasks such as off-cycle check processing, garnishment administration, and inbox management while also contributing to audits, reporting, and cross-functional projects. Job responsibilities subject to change based on business needs.

We are seeking an experienced Payroll Specialist with expertise in U.S. payroll processing using Workday. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage daily off-cycle check processing including ongoing audits, reconciliations, and compliance tasks. This role is hands-on and fast-paced, requiring the ability to balance daily operational work with monthly, quarterly, and annual deliverables.

$50$55/hourly

Duration:

9/1/2026 - 3/1/2027

Location:

Emeryville, CA Hybrid, 4 days onsite

- Process off-cycle checks three days per week
- Manage employee garnishments, including setup, auditing and monthly reconciliation
- Reconcile and post daily payroll GL entries in D365
- Perform monthly GL reconciliations
- Support regular payroll processing, including data validation and audits
- Assist with unclaimed property processing
- Manage high-volume Unclaimed Property and W-2 inboxes
- Assist with payroll audits and internal control reviews
- Support year-end processes
- Support ad-hoc reporting, audits, and cross-functional projects as needed

Qualifications:

- 3-5+ years' experience in US payroll processing
- Hands-on Workday Payroll experience (mandatory)
- Advanced excel skills Mandatory (ability to work with large volumes of data, vlookups, pivots, analysis, etc.)
- Strong attention to detail and prioritization skills
- Reliable and the ability to work independently and meet deadlines
- Excellent customer service and follow-through
- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
- Flexibility with job responsibilities

Ascend

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8729181728729007316?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=618&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2900715583263081627&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Ascend Talent Solutions Job Description**

**Job Description** \- With excellent organizational skills, the primary responsibility of the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist will be to assist the Accounting team to ensure the proper and accurate entry and coding of accounting related transactions, invoices, expense reports, and the timely submission of customer invoices and payments.  The successful Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist will be highly proficient in coding invoices to multiple cost centers conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system and excellent at applying payments accurately.  Strong internal and external facing communication skills is required to understand purchases, invoices and payments for proper allocation and reporting. Additional responsibilities for the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist include the following:

**Responsibilities Include:**

- Codes such items as invoices, vouchers, expense reports, check requests, etc. with correct codes conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system
- Handles all vendor correspondence via phone or email
- Prepares non-inventory purchase order requisitions.
- Attaches the corresponding purchase orders to incoming invoices with all supporting documentation.
- Investigates and resolves problems associated with processing of invoices and purchase orders.
- Prepares batch check runs, wire transfers, and ACH transactions.
- Assists with the processing of month end accruals for monthly financial reports, and monthly closings.
- Reconciles various accounts by identifying errors in posting or omissions by applying appropriate accounting standards.
- Receives, researches and resolves a variety of routine internal and external inquiries concerning account status, including communicating the resolution of discrepancies to appropriate persons.
- Prepare and send all customer billing.
- Produce the monthly aging report.
- Respond to customer billing inquiries, resend bills, and send collection emails.

**Position Requirements**

- 1 - 2 years accounts payable or general accounting experience
- 10-key by touch
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills; must be detail oriented, ability to multi-task
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other financial systems.

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree preferred.

**Benefits**

- Medical, Dental, and Vision

**Compensations**

- $23 -$25/hr

### Job Description

Job Description

CreativeMC ( is San Francisco's largest promotional product firm. Our client base includes: Meta, Google, Cisco, Grammerly, and more. CreativeMC partners with our clients to promote their business through stylized, branded products. In this role, you would work in our Financial District, San Francisco office.

The best candidates possess all the characteristics needed for success at CreativeMC including high-level organizational skills, project management aptitude, business savviness, relationship building skills, flexibility, positivity, creativity, and keenly honed common sense. Most importantly, you must be driven to win.

**YOUR REWARD:**

- _**Compensation:**_ $26 - $28 per hour DOE, eligible for overtime pay and an end-of-year bonus.
- _**Excellent Benefits:**_ 15 days annually accrued PTO, 10 paid holidays, medical, dental, vision insurance, 401k with 3-4% match
- _**ESOP**_(Employee-owned business), you will become eligible to receive annual shares of company stocks.
- _**Pay for your Commute:**_ Working in the office 4 days a week and one remote day includes payment for public transportation.

_**We have a vibrant, diverse and supportive culture and are looking for the right person to join our team. We enjoy a fun work culture with many spontaneous and planned events and celebrations.**_

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

_**Project Operations Assistance**_

- Serves as the point of contact on assigned projects, performs a variety of highly-skilled tasks
- Under the direction of a Brand Stylist, prepares purchase orders, contracts and product information for clients
- Assists with managing product production cycle; tracking vendor receipt of product, confirming production dates with vendors, shipping timelines, review of proofs with Brand Stylist; heads off potential problems with effective tracking and communications
- Enters ongoing transaction data using Salesforce
- Maintains all quote documentation with accurate pricing and configurations
- Responds to inquiries about client projects
- Reports any delays to Brand Stylists and/or managing director
- Interacts and communicates with individuals at all levels: sales, finance, warehouse
- Supports management in other facets of the business
- Remains up to date about design trends

**COMPETENCIES / REQUIREMENTS:**

- You must be able to work daily in our San Francisco office
- Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience
- Creative eye, with an interest in design, style and trends
- A minimum of 2 years working in an administrative role requiring high level computer skills including intermediate CRM software skills. (MS Office Suite, Google Suite, Slack, Salesforce, Slack, Canva, LinkedIn, and more)
- Basic experience in social media
- 2 or more years’ experience in internal and external customer service
- Fast paced project management experience with honed organizational skills
- Solid acumen with numbers and an analytical and strategic thinker
- Personable and responsive, with exceptional verbal and written communication skills
- Creative and persistent problem solver

**TO APPLY:**

If you feel this could be right for you, please provide your resume and cover letter to us; **please put “Project Operations Assistant” in the subject line.**

_**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**_

# Operations Coordinator

Constellation Research Center

[Berkeley, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Berkeley%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7560570881227126874?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5897&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6027819036719443322&crId=US_0US_0)

Operations CoordinatorThe Operations Coordinator role is focused on providing office, administrative, and customer support to our staff and the visitors hosted in our research center. This position will report to a member of the Shared Services team. This is an entry-level, operational development role. The aim is to give you skills and experience across a broad range of operational tasks, along with foundational context about AI safety. You'll start by building core operations skills, then have room to explore the operational areas that interest you most (e.g. events, comms, HR, facilities). The role isn't intended to be permanent. Most operations coordinators move on to other roles within a year. Our goal is to provide training and context that can help you support Constellation as well as other organizations in our network as they scale during a period of rapid growth and rising importance for AI safety. Past coordinators have gone on to roles at Coefficient Giving, Redwood Research, and other teams at Constellation. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, excellent interpersonal skills, and is excited to support AI safety research in a fast-paced and friendly work environment. (The vibe and pace of work is much closer to a growing startup than a traditional nonprofit.) Ideally, you also have a few years of office management, customer support, or administrative experience. In this role, you'll be the first person visitors and program participants meet when they arrive. You'll respond to support requests, maintain accurate records in our systems, troubleshoot and fix things around the office, and help facilitate special events. Our research center hosts many of the top experts in AI safety, and we want to foster a space that supports their productivity and helps them work as efficiently as possible. This is an in-person, full-time position. ##### Public Safety Dispatcher

The Public Safety Dispatcher serves as the primary communications link for the Department of Public Safety by receiving emergency and non-emergency calls for service, dispatching security officers and peace officers, monitoring alarms and surveillance systems, maintaining communication with field personnel, and coordinating responses with local emergency services when appropriate. This position requires sound judgment, professionalism, and the ability to remain calm while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Work is performed in a communications center operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## JOB DUTIES

General Recruitment

Perform full-cycle recruiting for full-time positions across all departments.

Partner with hiring managers to understand department staffing needs, job requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.

Post jobs through internal systems and external job boards, ensuring all postings are accurate, compelling, and compliant.

Source candidates through outreach, networking, social media, industry associations, and employee referrals.

Screen applicants, conduct phone interviews, and present qualified candidates to hiring managers.

Coordinate interview scheduling, feedback collection, and follow-up communication with candidates.

Maintain regular communication with candidates to ensure a smooth and professional experience.

Track recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, source, pipeline activity, and ongoing hiring trends.

Other duties as assigned for full-time recruitment.

College & Intern Recruitment

Coordinate and register the company for university career fairs, networking events, and campus recruitment activities.

Serve as the face of the company during campus engagements, career fairs, presentations, and site tours.

Manage sponsorships for targeted clubs, student chapters, and academic departments at partnered universities.

Maintain strong relationships with universities, career services, and relevant engineering/construction-related organizations.

Plan and coordinate jobsite tours and student visits.

Oversee collection, sorting, and management of resumes from events and university partners.

Conduct initial or secondary interviews for internship and entry-level candidates depending on position needs.

Track and report campus recruitment activity, including candidate pipelines, event attendance, and outreach metrics.

Collaborate with internal representatives and hiring managers to support participation in campus events and career fairs.

Prepare and print job descriptions, event materials, and other recruitment information.

Coordinate packaging, shipment, and inventory of materials and branded swag for fairs and student events.

Partner with the Marketing team to upkeep promotional materials.

Maintain organized records of event logistics, costs, and outcomes.

Support other recruitment initiatives as needed, including job postings, applicant screening, scheduling, and candidate communication.

Represent the company’s culture, values, and opportunities with professionalism and enthusiasm.

Ensure consistent messaging and professional presentation in all recruitment activities and materials.

Other duties as needed for college and intern recruitment.

General HR Duties

Provide backup support to HR members during peak periods, absences, or special projects.

Assist with maintaining employee records, HRIS data entry, and document management.

Respond to employee inquiries and route issues to appropriate HR staff.

Other duties as assigned.

## QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or related field preferred.

2–3 years of recruiting or HR experience; experience in construction/engineering a plus.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage logistics across multiple events and deadlines.

Willingness to travel for career fairs, site visits, and university engagements.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with various departments.

# Office Manager

$19 - $21 per hour

Senior Helpers

[South Pasadena, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/South-Pasadena%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8214876368451304912?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6635&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5885187588689121822&crId=US_0US_0)

## Office Manager

Lead your office team to success! As our Office Manager, we will depend on you to coordinate general office activities, assist with billing and payroll, maintain physical and electronic files, and support other departments as needed.

Why Work for Senior Helpers of Pasadena?

- Great Place to Work Certified
- Autonomy We encourage our team members independence and believe in our team to complete their job duties without micromanaging.
- Task Variety We provide an engaging workday that uses your various skill sets to avoid monotony.

Job Description:

Customer Service

- Ensure all communication is sent in a timely manner according to policy.
- Answer and screen incoming phone calls in a pleasant, courteous manner
- Input client leads into home care software and create and send client welcome packets and prospect information.

Payroll & Recruitment

- Collect and organize timesheets and verify/reconcile against scheduling calendar in home care software; track late, missing, and incorrect timesheets.
- Complete caregiver and internal payroll according to schedule.
- Review timesheets for any significant change in client status and indicate them in the caregiver notes section and properly document the information.
- Complete caregiver reference checks and criminal background checks
- Create new hire packets, employee handbooks, assist with training and orientation.
- Verify complete caregiver information in the file after hiring.
- Input caregiver information into home care software

Clerical:

- Prepare client and caregiver files including Care Plan Binders, Client Welcome Packets, Employment Paperwork, and other documentation.
- Perform general office functions such as sorting mail, data input, and file maintenance, ensuring all information is properly filed, organized, and easily accessible.
- Complete other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
- Proficient in Excel, Microsoft, Hubspot

Job Qualifications:

- Minimum of two years in an office managerial setting
- Ability to communicate pleasantly and effectively with callers and internal staff.
- Experience with a variety of the home care concepts, practices, and procedures
- Team player, excellent verbal and written communication skills, adaptable in different situations, possesses excellent client interaction skills.

Job Benefits:

- $19.00 - $21.00 an hour

About Senior Helpers:

We are an independently owned and operated franchisee of SH Franchising, LLC dba Senior Helpers. Senior Helpers has been the nation's premier franchisor of in-home senior care franchisees since 2005, with locations across the country. Our services range from specialized care for those with chronic diseases to companion services for seniors looking for assistance with daily activities. Our mission is to provide compassionate care and improve the quality of life for our clients, their families, and our employees.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, and local laws.

# Administrative Coordinator

Tekwissen

[Santa Monica, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Santa-Monica%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6386776674049635900?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6620&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1990157307899603224&crId=US_0US_0)

**Overview:**

TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world-wide. The below job opportunity is with one of our Biotech clients who researches develop and commercializes drugs. The company focuses primarily on antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and influenza, including Harvoni and Sovaldi.

**Position: Administrative Coordinator**

**Location: Santa Monica, CA 91773**

**Duration: 12 Months**

**Job Type: Temporary Assignment**

**Work Type: Onsite**

**Job Description:**

- The Administrative Coordinator provides high-level administrative and operational support to senior leaders and cross-functional teams within Process Development.
- This role is responsible for managing executive calendars, coordinating meetings and events, supporting organizational communications, facilitating onboarding and offboarding activities, and driving administrative processes that enable efficient team operations.
- The position serves as a key point of coordination across multiple functions and stakeholders, ensuring effective execution of business priorities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Manage complex calendars, meeting logistics, travel arrangements, and expense reporting for senior leaders.
- Coordinate leadership team meetings, prepare agendas, capture action items, and track follow-up activities.
- Support department communications, presentations, organizational announcements, and team events.
- Facilitate employee and contractor onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and organizational changes.
- Maintain organizational charts, distribution lists, team repositories, and administrative records.
- Coordinate cross-functional activities, leadership reviews, all-hands meetings, and special projects.
- Serve as a liaison between leaders, employees, contractors, and business partners to ensure timely communication and issue resolution.
- Support continuous improvement of administrative processes, tools, and operational workflows.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
- Experience supporting senior executives, directors, or leadership teams in a corporate environment.
- Strong organizational, communication, and project coordination skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain confidentiality, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

North Star Company

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1192290003954941831?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6490&pageType=7&jobAge=402&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4387968269756369249&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Job Description

**Summary/Objective:** The Office Manager oversees the administrative operations of a roll forming plant. This role connects customers, vendors, the production floor, and accounting, ensuring all orders and records are handled accurately and on time.

**Essential Functions:**

- Serve as the primary customer service contact for key accounts, including quotes, work orders, labels, RMAs, credits and debits.
- Create and maintain customer accounts; run customer inventory and sales reports as needed.
- Generate and send daily customer invoices through Oracle; prepare invoices such as scrap metal and warehouse fees.
- Request and compare vendor quotes on price and lead time.
- Place monthly aluminum orders and coordinate outside processing vendors (anodizing, painting, extrusions and fabrication).
- Prepare accounts payable documentation by verifying receivers against quotes and invoices, and handle invoices.
- Process employee time cards for payroll, verifying regular and overtime hours, time-off requests and timekeeping compliance.
- Receive incoming metal and process slit orders into inventory; run daily slit-needs and forecasting reports.
- Create and update part numbers, bills of materials, routings and price lists in Oracle.
- Maintain production records, including QC, inventory, efficiency, costing, WIP and MOQ reports.
- Coordinate monthly safety training and maintain sign-in records; support customer service and purchasing audits.
- Prepare bills of lading and keep office and facility supplies stocked.

**Other Duties:** This job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. Duties may be added, changed or reassigned at management's discretion.

**Work Environment:** This position works primarily in a plant office, with regular time on the production floor and in the warehouse areas.

**Physical Demands:** The role involves extended periods of computer work along with walking the production floor and warehouse areas. Production areas can be noisy, and PPE is required in designated areas.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

- High school diploma or equivalent required.
- 3+ years of office management or administration experience.
- Experience with an ERP system, preferably Oracle.
- Working knowledge of purchasing, accounts payable and payroll timekeeping.
- Strong Microsoft Excel and Office skills.
- Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience in metals, roll forming, coil processing or slitting.
- Familiarity with bills of materials, routings and units of measure.
- Associate or bachelor's degree in business or a related field.

**Core Competencies**

- Organization and time management.
- Accuracy and attention to detail.
- Clear communication across departments.
- Problem-solving and initiative.
- Commitment to continuous improvement.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Business Office Manager**

**Location:** Pasadena, California

**Company:** Golden Rose Care Center

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** $33 - $37 HOURLY

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Office Manager to join our team at Golden Rose Care Center, a skilled nursing and subacute facility providing comprehensive post-acute, long-term, and high-acuity clinical care. As a Business Office Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the overall business office operations run smoothly and efficiently, safeguarding facility assets, and maximizing cash flow.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

As a Business Office Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day activities of the business office, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations, and providing support to the administrative staff. Your duties will include:

- Demonstrating commitment to our company's mission, values, and standards of ethical behavior

- Models a positive and professional image that emulates the organization's mission and encourages a spirit of cooperation with co-workers

- Ensures that all residents are treated fairly, with kindness, dignity, and respect, and their rights are protected at all times

- Compiles, audits, and documents accounting/financial data for the Care Center

- Performs other related duties as required


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

• Demonstrates knowledge of facility and departmental quality improvement activities and/or participates in quality improvement meetings

• Recommends any equipment and supplies needed for the department as well as any departmental improvements

• Participates in and/or leads on-the-job training, in-service education, and orientation programs

• Assists in development of department budget and ensures expenses are within budgeted parameters

• Oversees payroll function, ensuring its accuracy and timeliness

• Oversees the Resident Trust Account and assures that all regulations are followed regarding the fund

• Ensures that all business records and files are accurate, complete, and up-to-date

• Performs follow-up reviews of issues identified by financial/administrative review and internal audit reports

**REQUIREMENTS:**

- 2-4 years experience in a healthcare billing, preferably in long-term care environment

- Bachelor's or Associate degree from an accredited college with specialization in business or accounting preferred

- Supervisory experience required

- Public Notary preferred

- Ability to understand and implement healthcare reimbursement, billing, and accounting principles

- Ability to understand, control, and track direct spending and labor budgets


**SEEKING:**

If you are a motivated and experienced professional with a strong background in healthcare billing and accounting, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. If you share our passion for providing high-quality care and attention to our residents, please submit your application today.

##### Office Clerk

The Office Clerk is responsible for ensuring that front office administrative tasks are handled appropriately. The Office Clerk communicates with employees, visitors and customers and supports local management. This position typically reports to the Office Manager or General Manager.

Responsibilities

- Ensures security processes are followed with regard to the front desk (driver and visitor sign in).
- Answers and routes all telephone calls in a polite manner, taking messages and routing to proper individuals in a timely manner.
- Provides scheduling of all inbound and outbound freight in compliance customer and operation departments.
- Coordinates receiving and shipping documents verifying accuracy.
- Gathers and maintains all data and records relative to shipping and receiving activities.
- Verifies accuracy on shipping orders and shipping quantities matching picking documents.
- Assists in resolving customer discrepancies.
- Collects all documentation for inbound freight and route to the proper recording keeping unit.
- Directs and oversees the pallet control and exchange program.
- Facility AR/AP and vendor invoices responsibilities.
- Responsible for running specific customer reports and scanning invoices.
- Provides assistance on special projects at the discretion of the Lead Customer Service Representative (CSR), CSR Supervisor or Office Manager.
- Files appropriate paperwork for facility as required.
- Other administrative tasks as directed by local management specific to the facility's needs

Qualifications

- High School Diploma
- Strong computer knowledge including MS Office applications, specifically strong excel
- Basic typing skills, Familiarity with 10-key
- Shipping software systems including UPS and Federal Express
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Must be able to work in varying facility conditions including poor lighting and ventilation, exposure to noise, dust, LPG fumes, product orders, heat during the summer and cold during the winter
- Ability and availability to work irregular or extended hours including nights, weekends and potentially holidays as needed by the customer
